title: In-House Media Buyer - Meta, Medical Clinic Lead Gen (Head of Media Buying track)
description:
READ THIS BLOCK FIRST. IT SAVES US BOTH TIME.



If any of these are untrue, close the tab. We will not make exceptions and we

will not read the application.



- You have personally managed at least $500,000 in Meta ad spend. Not "worked

  on an account that spent that." You, in the account, making the calls

- You have run lead generation, not ecommerce. Appointments, consultations,

  calls booked. If your entire history is ROAS on a Shopify store, this is a

  different job than the one you know

- You have worked in medical, dental, aesthetics, or another high ticket

  service where a lead becomes a booked appointment and then a sale weeks later.

  Or a vertical close enough that you can explain why it is close enough

- You want to be in house, exclusively, for one company. Not a retainer client.

  Not a fractional seat alongside four other brands. Not your agency taking us

  on. One company, all of your attention



That last one is not negotiable and it is the one people try to negotiate. If

you run your own agency or freelance for other clients, we are not the right

fit, no matter how good you are.



WHO WE ARE



Novaris Global. We run paid acquisition for private medical clinics, mostly

plastic surgery and aesthetics. Our clients are in Singapore and we are

expanding.



Here is the part that changes everything about this job. We do not charge a flat

retainer. We take a percentage of the revenue we generate for the clinic. If the

ads produce nothing, we make nothing.



So this is not a role where you optimize toward a dashboard number and file a

report. Your decisions are directly, immediately, and painfully connected to

whether this company makes money. Cost per lead is not the scoreboard. Cost per

booked consultation is closer. Cost per surgery performed is the real one, and

that is the number you will be judged on and paid on.



Most media buyers have never been held to that. The ones who have tend to be

very good, because there is nowhere to hide.



THE ROLE



You own paid acquisition. All of it, across every client.



- Strategy, structure, budget, and every decision inside the ad accounts

- Testing. What we try next, why, in what order, and what it would take to

  convince you that you were wrong

- Creative direction on the media buying side. You do not cut the videos, but

  you d
 what needs to exist, what the next 30 ads have to prove, and which

  angle died and why

- Tracking and attribution. Pixel, CAPI, offline conversions, UTMs, and the

  chain from an impression to a surgery that actually happened

- The whole funnel, not just the account. Landing page, form, speed to first

  contact, show rate, close rate. Half the wins in this business are downstream

  of the ad and most media buyers pretend that half is somebody else's problem

- Reporting that tells the truth, including when the truth is that this week was

  bad and here is why



WHO THIS IS ACTUALLY FOR



We are looking for a specific kind of person, and it is not the person with the

best resume.



It is the person who cannot leave a number alone.



You know if this is you. You open the ads manager on a Sunday because something

felt off on Friday and it has been sitting in your head since. You have built

spreadsheets nobody asked for. You get genuinely irritated by an account you

cannot explain. When a campaign works, your first reaction is not relief, it is

"why," and you will not be satisfied until you can say exactly why, because a

win you cannot explain is a win you cannot repeat.



You have opinions about attribution windows. You have been in an argument about

broad versus interest stacking. You have a view on where Meta is right now and

it is your own view, formed from your own accounts, not something you absorbed

from a YouTube video.



You do not accept "the account is doing fine." Fine is an insult. There is

always another test, another segment, another cut of the data, another thing

that has been quietly wrong for three weeks that nobody looked at.



If reading that felt like being described, keep going. If it felt exhausting,

we are genuinely not the right place and no amount of money will fix that.



THE THING WE WANT MOST



We want someone better at this than the founder.



I run media buying here now and I am good at it. I do not want a pair of hands

to execute my ideas. I want someone who looks at how we do things and says "this

is wrong, here is why, here is what we should do instead," and is right often

enough that I stop arguing.



You will have real authority over the accounts. You will also have to defend

your calls with evidence, because you will be arguing with someone who knows the

platform. That is the job. If you want a boss who does not understand what you

do, we are the wrong company. If you have spent years being overruled by people

who understood less than you did, this might be the best part of the offer.



WHERE THIS GOES



Head of Media Buying at Novaris Global.



Right now that is one person, which is why we are hiring carefully. As we take

on clinics, you stop running every account personally and start building the

team that does, setting the standards, and training the buyers under you. In

house, on the team, in the decisions, not a contractor we send a Slack message

to when something breaks.



WHAT WE PAY



A base, plus a share of what your accounts generate.



We are not going to post a number, because the number depends entirely on who

you turn out to be, and the honest answer is that we will pay well above market

for the right person and nothing at all for the wrong one. What we will tell you

is the structure, because the structure is the point: we get paid on client

revenue, so you get paid on client revenue. When you find something that works,

you are not asking for a raise, you already got one.



If you are excellent and you want a ceiling, we are the wrong company. If you

are excellent and you have been annoyed for years that your results made someone

else rich, read that paragraph again.



WHAT WILL GET YOU REJECTED IMMEDIATELY



- An application that talks about strategy and never mentions a number

- Cost per lead presented as a result, with nothing about what happened to those

  leads afterward

- "I scaled a client from 5k to 50k a month" with no vertical, no timeframe, no

  cost per acquisition, and no mention of whether it stayed there

- Any suggestion that you would keep your other clients

- A generic application. We can tell within one line, and so can you



HOW TO APPLY



This application is long on purpose. We are not doing introductory calls with

people who are not close, so everything we would ask on that call is below.

Answer it well and the next conversation we have is a serious one.



Start your message with the word ANDROMEDA.



PART 1. YOUR NUMBERS.



- Total Meta spend you have personally managed, lifetime

- The most you have managed in a single month, and in which account

- Verticals, honestly, with the medical or high ticket service ones first

- For your best lead gen account: what it spent, over what period, cost per

  lead, cost per booked appointment, show rate, and cost per closed sale. If you

  do not have the downstream numbers, say so plainly and tell us why they were

  not available to you. That answer tells us a lot and a missing number is not

  automatically a problem. Making one up is

- Screenshots welcome. Blur the client name if you need to



PART 2. FOUR QUESTIONS. SHORT ANSWERS ARE FINE. VAGUE ANSWERS ARE NOT.



1. An account is spending $300 a day. Last week cost per lead was $52. This

   week it is $31 and lead volume is up 40 percent. The clinic tells you they

   booked fewer consultations this week than last. Where do you look first, and

   what are the three most likely explanations in order of probability?



2. One ad set has been stable for three weeks at $200 a day with a $180 cost per

   booked consultation. You need it at $600 a day within a month. Walk us

   through exactly how you do it, and tell us what you expect to break first.



3. A campaign has 30 ads live. Two of them are taking 90 percent of the spend.

   The other 28 have spent almost nothing. The client wants to know why they

   paid for 28 ads that are not running. What do you tell them, and what do you

   do with those 28?



4. The clinic's front desk takes six hours to call a new lead. You have no

   authority over the front desk and the clinic owner is defensive about his

   staff. What is that costing, and what do you actually do about it?



PART 3. YOUR READ ON THE PLATFORM.



Two paragraphs on where Meta is right now and what it means for how accounts

should be run in 2026. Your own opinion, from your own accounts. We are not

looking for a correct answer, we are looking for a real one. If you agree with

the consensus, say why. If you think the consensus is wrong, that is more

interesting.



PART 4. TEAR SOMETHING APART.



Go to the Meta Ad Library. Find any plastic surgery or aesthetic clinic running

ads right now, anywhere in the world. Look at what they are running.



Tell us what you would change and why. Be specific and be harsh. This is the

part we read most carefully, because it is the only part where we get to watch

you think instead of watching you describe yourself.



PART 5. OPTIONAL, AND IT COUNTS.



A Loom, ten minutes or less, sharing your screen inside an account you actually

run. Walk us through what you are looking at and what you would do next. Blur

whatever you need to. Nothing else in this application is as convincing as this.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



We read every complete application. If it is strong, we get on a call, and that

call is a working session on a real account of ours, not an interview about your

strengths and weaknesses.



If that goes well, a paid project on a live account before anyone commits to

anything, because you should also get to find out whether we are worth working

for.

title: Creative Strategist – E-Commerce / Meta Ads
description:
We are looking for a Creative Strategist to join our growing e-commerce team and help us consistently develop new winning ad concepts for Meta/Facebook.



This is a long-term position for someone who understands direct-response marketing, customer psychology, creative research, and performance advertising.



What You’ll Do

Research competitors, Meta Ad Library, customer reviews, Reddit, Amazon, TikTok, and other sources to identify new opportunities

Research our target customer, pain points, desires, objections, and buying motivations

Develop new creative concepts, hooks, angles, and offers

Write clear creative briefs for our video editors and designers

Write scripts for UGC, VSL-style, advertorial, testimonial, problem/solution, and other direct-response ads

Find strong reference ads and explain exactly how we can adapt the concept to our product

Analyze existing winning and losing creatives to understand what is working

Develop new iterations and variations of winning ads

Continuously bring fresh concepts to the creative pipeline

Work closely with our media buyer, editors, and management team

Review performance data and use the results to d
 what we should test next

What We're Looking For



You should have:



Experience with e-commerce / DTC advertising

Strong understanding of Meta Ads

Experience developing performance-focused creative concepts

Strong direct-response marketing knowledge

Good copywriting and scriptwriting skills

Understanding of hooks, angles, offers, awareness levels, and customer psychology

Ability to analyze advertising performance and learn from the data

Strong competitor and customer research skills

Ability to clearly communicate your ideas to editors and designers

Excellent written English

Ability to work independently and consistently deliver new ideas



Most importantly:



We are NOT looking for someone who simply finds competitor ads and tells us to copy them.



We want someone who can look at an ad and understand:



Why does this work?



What customer is it targeting?



What pain point or desire is driving the sale?



What is the core angle and hook?



How can we create a better version for our product?



What should we test next based on the results?



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Your previous experience as a Creative Strategist

E-commerce/DTC brands or niches you've worked with

Examples of creative briefs you've created

Examples of scripts, hooks, or concepts you've developed

Examples of ads that came from your concepts, if available

Your experience analyzing Meta Ads performance

Your expected monthly salary

title: Full- Time Senior Google Ads Strategist for Australian lead generation accounts
description:
Read this first



This role is a strong fit only if all of the following apply to you:

-You have independently led Google Ads strategy across five or more concurrent client accounts in a digital marketing agency.

-You are highly capable in Google Search and Performance Max for lead generation, not primarily ecommerce.

-You can independently audit and diagnose GA4 and Google Tag Manager conversion-tracking issues and coordinate technical fixes when required.

-You are comfortable working with regulated sectors such as legal, healthcare and financial services.

-You can overlap substantially with Australian Eastern Time.

-You remain deeply hands-on. You personally implement and optimise campaigns rather than only directing others or reviewing reports.



How to apply

Start your application with the words BLUE PPC.



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered, regardless of experience.



Then complete our screening form here 



We will only review candidates who submit the completed screening form. An application message alone is not sufficient.



Position overview

We are a growing Melbourne-based digital marketing agency hiring a Senior Google Ads Strategist to lead strategy and take full operational ownership of nine active Australian client accounts.



Our portfolio focuses on professional services and allied health, including psychologists, physiotherapists, lawyers, dentists, mortgage brokers, executive coaches and buyers advocates. These are lead-generation accounts where success means qualified calls, booked consultations, viable cases and new clients or patients, not traffic or vanity metrics.



You will lead Google Ads strategy and execution across the portfolio from day one. You will independently determine how each account should be structured, optimised, measured and improved, then personally implement the work.



Initially, the agency owner will retain primary responsibility for client relationships and lead client meetings. You will provide the strategic recommendations, account analysis and talking points that inform those conversations. As you demonstrate strong strategic judgement and communication, there is a genuine path into direct client leadership and a PPC Lead position.



You will complete a structured handover covering each account’s objectives, campaign structure, budgets, conversion actions, performance history, active tests, known risks and immediate next actions.



Why this role is worth your time

You will step into an established portfolio with documented account history, clear client context and organised account notes.



You will also receive:

-A full-time, long-term remote position.

-Complete strategic and operational ownership of nine active Australian accounts managing approximately US$12,500 per -month in combined ad spend.

-Direct communication with the agency owner, with no unnecessary management layers.

-Genuine autonomy to make and implement strategic decisions.

-Clear performance expectations and accountability from day one.

-All required tools and access from day one.

-A formal performance and compensation review after 60 to 90 days.

-A quarterly performance bonus tied to account retention, tracking integrity and lead-quality outcomes. Details will be discussed with the successful candidate.

-A genuine progression path into client-facing leadership and broader paid-media team leadership.



What you will own



Strategy and account direction

-Take full strategic and operational ownership of all nine Google Ads accounts.

-Review each client’s commercial goals, services, locations, budgets, historical performance, lead quality and conversion journey.

-Develop and document a clear strategy for each account, including what should be tested, why it matters and how success will be measured.

-Translate commercial goals into campaign structures, targeting decisions, bidding approaches, budgets and testing priorities.

-Challenge weak assumptions and recommend a different direction when the evidence supports it.

-Identify where campaign structure, targeting, messaging, measurement or landing pages are limiting qualified-lead performance.

-Prioritise qualified enquiries, calls, consultation bookings, viable cases and new clients or patients rather than lead volume alone.

-Document major strategic decisions and the commercial reasoning behind them.



Campaign management and optimisation

-Personally build, manage and optimise Search, Performance Max, remarketing and relevant Display campaigns.

-Structure Performance Max campaigns for lead generation, including asset groups, audience signals, search themes and appropriate budget separation.

-Conduct ongoing search-term reviews and maintain accurate negative-keyword coverage.

-Manage keywords, match types, audiences, locations, schedules, devices, creative assets and exclusions.

-Apply smart bidding with independent judgement and understand when automation needs stronger controls or better data.

-Monitor budget pacing across all nine accounts and identify overdelivery, underdelivery and performance anomalies before they become client problems.

-Maintain strong account hygiene and document significant changes, tests and outcomes.



Conversion tracking and data quality

-Audit conversion tracking across Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, website forms, phone calls and call-tracking platforms where applicable.

-Implement or validate enhanced conversions for leads where appropriate.

-Confirm primary and secondary conversion actions are correctly configured.

-Ensure bidding strategies optimise toward meaningful business outcomes rather than weak or misleading conversion actions.

-Detect duplicate, missing, inflated or misleading conversion data.

-Investigate tracking quality rather than assuming the data is correct because conversions appear in the account.

-Explain measurement issues, their commercial impact and the correct resolution.

-Coordinate technical implementation with developers or the agency owner when required.

-You are not expected to be a full-time analytics engineer. You must be capable of independently diagnosing measurement problems and directing the right resolution.



Lead quality and commercial performance

-Evaluate performance beyond cost per lead by assessing lead relevance, intent and commercial value.

-Identify campaigns, keywords, search terms, locations or offers generating poor-quality enquiries and act on them.

-Recommend improvements to targeting, messaging, forms, landing pages and conversion definitions.

-Understand that professional-services and allied-health leads behave differently. Consultations, appointments, viable legal cases and high-value enquiries require different strategies and qualification standards.

-Connect campaign decisions to commercially relevant outcomes.

-Escalate material risks early with a clear diagnosis and recommended response.



Ad messaging and landing-page recommendations

-Develop or coordinate clear, relevant advertising messages and assets aligned with each client’s services, audience and location.

-Recognise advertising restrictions affecting legal, healthcare and financial-services clients, and flag potential compliance risks.

-Identify landing-page problems affecting relevance, trust, conversion rate or lead quality.

-Provide clear recommendations and coordinate improvements with the appropriate team member.

-You will not be expected to design or build landing pages yourself.



Reporting and communication

-Build and maintain client-ready reports in Looker Studio or an equivalent platform.

-Provide accurate data, plain-English analysis and commercially relevant recommendations.

-Explain what changed, why it changed, what the result was and what should happen next.

-Give the agency owner concise strategic talking points before client meetings.

-Maintain clear updates on performance, budgets, risks, active tests and unresolved blockers.

-Attend one internal weekly performance review, with other updates handled asynchronously.

-Never produce reports that merely list platform metrics without interpretation or a recommended action.



Portfolio and workload

You will own nine active Australian client accounts across professional services and allied health, managing approximately US$12,500 per month in combined ad spend.



The portfolio includes:

Psychology and allied health

Legal services

Dentistry

Physiotherapy

Mortgage broking

Executive and high-performance coaching

Buyers advocacy



These are lead-generation accounts. Performance is judged through qualified calls, enquiries, consultation bookings, appointments, viable cases and new clients or patients, not impressions, clicks or raw lead volume.



Your first 14 days

Within your first two weeks, you will be expected to complete:



-An initial tracking audit across all nine accounts, with primary conversions confirmed and duplication, inflation or missing measurement identified.

-An account triage summary covering current performance, known risks, budget pacing and immediate priorities for each account.

-An initial 90-day strategy, testing and optimisation roadmap identifying the highest-priority improvements and measurement needs across the portfolio.

-A budget-pacing overview confirming which accounts are on track and which require immediate action.

-Clear documentation of unresolved issues that need technical support or agency-owner input.



These deliverables are designed to assess your strategic judgement, ability to prioritise and working style. They are not a requirement to rebuild nine accounts within two weeks.



What success looks like after 60 to 90 days

-You independently lead strategy and manage day-to-day execution across all nine accounts without daily supervision.

-Every account has clear commercial goals, a documented strategy, current performance status, active tests and known risks.

-Strategic decisions are proactive and evidence-led rather than reactive or dependent on agency-owner instructions.

-Budgets are paced accurately, and material anomalies are identified before they become client problems.

-Conversion tracking has been reviewed across the portfolio, with problems resolved, documented or escalated.

-Optimisation decisions reflect qualified-lead outcomes rather than surface-level platform metrics.

-Reporting is accurate, commercially relevant, written in plain English and delivered on time.

-The agency owner is never surprised by an avoidable account issue.

You proactively recommend improvements to campaign structures, tracking, messaging and landing pages.

You consistently explain the strategic reasoning behind your decisions.



Must-haves

Please apply only if you have:



At least five years of active, current Google Ads experience managing live client accounts.

Proven experience independently leading Google Ads strategy across five or more concurrent client accounts in a digital marketing agency.

Strong experience running lead-generation campaigns for service-based businesses.

Advanced practical knowledge of Google Search campaigns, including keyword strategy, match types, negative keywords, bidding, ad messaging and account structure.

Demonstrated ability to structure and manage Performance Max for lead generation, including asset groups, audience signals, search themes and channel-level interpretation.

Proven ability to translate commercial goals into clear campaign strategies and testing priorities.

The confidence to challenge weak assumptions and recommend a different strategic direction when required.

Demonstrated ability to audit and troubleshoot conversion tracking in GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

Experience implementing or validating enhanced conversions for leads.

Proficiency in producing client-ready reporting through Looker Studio or an equivalent platform.

Strong commercial judgement and the ability to assess performance beyond platform metrics.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong attention to detail and consistent documentation habits.

Confidence making independent strategic decisions and explaining your reasoning clearly.

Reliable internet, a suitable full-time remote setup and consistent availability overlapping Australian Eastern Time.



Nice-to-haves

Recent experience working with Australian agencies or Australian clients.

Experience with law firms, allied health, financial services or other regulated professional-services sectors.

Familiarity with advertising restrictions affecting legal, healthcare and financial services.

Experience with call-tracking platforms and offline conversion imports.

Experience using Google Ads scripts or automation for account monitoring and alerting.

Demand Gen campaign experience.

Experience building Looker Studio dashboards for multiple clients.

Experience coordinating with copywriters, developers and publishers on landing-page improvements.

Previous client-facing experience presenting results or attending client meetings.

Experience coaching or mentoring junior paid-media specialists.

Current Google Ads Search or Measurement certification.



Who will succeed in this role

You are likely to thrive here if you:



Take ownership without waiting to be chased.

Think strategically while remaining deeply hands-on.

Form your own point of view about what each account needs.

Investigate tracking and data quality rather than accepting platform data at face value.

Care about qualified leads and commercial outcomes, not impressions, clicks or platform scores.

Communicate risks before they become client problems.

Make confident decisions and document the reasoning behind them.

Manage nine accounts simultaneously without losing track of important details.

Know when to use Google’s automation and when stronger strategic controls are required.

Want to progress into client-facing leadership and broader paid-media leadership over time.



This role will not suit you if

You need daily task-by-task supervision.

Your experience is primarily in-house or limited to one account at a time.

You have not managed at least five concurrent client accounts in an agency environment.

Your experience focuses primarily on ecommerce rather than service-based lead generation.

You prefer strategy but no longer implement campaign changes yourself.

You are strongest at implementation but expect someone else to determine the strategy.

You rely on automated platform recommendations as your primary optimisation method.

You focus on impressions, clicks or raw lead volume without assessing lead quality.



Tools we use

Our toolset includes Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, call-tracking platforms where applicable, Asana, Google Drive, WordPress, ChatGPT and Claude.



You do not need prior experience with every tool listed. You must demonstrate mastery of the underlying Google Ads strategy, measurement, analysis and account-management workflows.



Compensation and working arrangement

Full-time contractor role, approximately 40 hours per week.

Long-term remote position.

US$2,500 to US$3,000 per month, depending on demonstrated capability and experience.

The upper end of the range is reserved for candidates with strong Australian-market experience, advanced measurement skills and the potential to progress into client-facing leadership.

Payment fortnightly or monthly, based on your preference.

Formal performance and compensation review after 60 to 90 days.

Quarterly performance bonus tied to account retention, tracking integrity and lead-quality outcomes. Details will be discussed with the successful candidate.

Preferred schedule of approximately 12 pm to 9 pm Melbourne time, with an agreed working arrangement.

All required tools and access provided from day one.

Immediate start preferred.



Hiring process

Application and screening form review.

Five-minute introductory call covering communication and fit.

Fifteen-minute technical interview covering strategy, optimisation, tracking quality and lead-quality judgement.

Paid practical exercise based on a realistic agency account scenario, scoped to approximately 60 to 90 minutes.

Reference checks.

Offer to the successful candidate.



This is a permanent, full-time role. We are ready to move quickly for the right person.

title: VIDEO EDITOR — LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP
description:
???? VIDEO EDITOR — LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP | $8 PER REEL



I'm looking for a reliable video editor to work with long-term.



I run an online fitness coaching business for men 300lbs+ and regularly create short-form content and ads for Instagram,
 and other platforms: 



I'm NOT looking for someone to work 40 hours a week.



I'm looking for an editing partner I can keep on standby and message whenever I have content that needs editing.



Sometimes I'll need 1 video edited.

Sometimes I'll send you 5–20 videos at once.

Other times there may be nothing for a few days.



The important thing is that when I send you an edit, you're reliable, responsive and can get it done quickly.



???? PAY

$8 USD per reel

- Videos are typically 1–2 minutes maximum.

- I'm looking for someone I can build a long-term relationship with, not someone for a one-off project.



???? THE STYLE I'M LOOKING FOR



I want someone who can create high-retention, modern short-form videos and ads similar to the style/content on:

DFitz Academy: 

Biology Decoded: 

Instagram reference: 



The editing should feel:

• Fast-paced

• Clean

• Professional

• Premium

• High-retention

• Attention-grabbing

• Native to Instagram/Reels

• Not overly flashy or cheesy

• Strong subtitles/captions

• Good pacing and cuts

• Strategic zooms/punch-ins

• B-roll when appropriate

• Visual emphasis on important words/points

• Designed to keep someone watching



I do NOT want generic CapCut-style edits with random effects thrown everywhere.

I want someone who understands why an edit works, not someone who simply knows how to cut clips together.



???? AUDIO QUALITY — BIG BONUS



Bonus points if you're genuinely good at audio editing.

I want the final videos to sound clean, crisp and professional.



Things like:

• Removing background noise

• Improving voice clarity

• Balancing audio levels

• Cleaning up echo/room noise

• Making speech sound more professional

• Adding subtle sound effects when appropriate

• Making sure music/B-roll doesn't overpower the voice



You don't need to be a professional audio engineer.



But if you know how to take average raw audio and make it sound significantly better, that's a BIG plus.

Basically:

Don't just make the video look good — make it sound good too.



???? ENGLISH IS IMPORTANT

You must have good English.

A big part of the job involves creating accurate subtitles, so you need to be able to understand what I'm saying and correctly subtitle the videos.

You'll need to have:

• Good English comprehension

• Good spelling and grammar

• Accurate subtitle/captioning skills

• Good attention to detail

• Clear communication



If your English is poor, please don't apply.



⚡ RELIABILITY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT

This is probably the most important part of the job.

I don't need you available 24/7.

But when I message you:

"Hey, I've got 3 videos for you."

I need to know that you'll actually respond and get them done.



I'm looking for someone who:

• Responds reasonably quickly

• Meets deadlines

• Doesn't disappear

• Takes initiative

• Can work independently

• Pays attention to detail

• Is open to feedback

• Can follow instructions

• Wants to build a long-term working relationship



Initially, I'll give you examples and feedback so you understand exactly how I want the videos edited.



Once you understand my style, I want you to be able to take a raw video and run with it.



???? WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE

I'll generally provide:

• Raw video footage

• The topic/script/context

• Examples of the editing style

• Any specific instructions



You handle the editing and deliver the finished reel.



I'm not expecting you to be available all day.



I just need to know that when I send work through, you can communicate with me and get it done.



⭐ WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

You'd be a great fit if you're:

• Experienced with short-form content

• Comfortable editing talking-head videos

• Experienced with Instagram Reels

• Good at editing ads

• Very good at subtitles/captions

• Good with pacing and retention

• Good with audio cleanup

• Detail-oriented

• Fast without sacrificing quality

• Fluent in English

• Reliable and responsive

• Comfortable receiving feedback

• Able to work independently

• Looking for a long-term client



???? PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

I'm not looking for someone who just wants another job where they clock in and clock out.



I'm looking for a video editing partner I can rely on.



If we work well together, there can be regular batches of content and ongoing work for the long term.



I'm much more interested in finding one excellent editor I can trust than constantly hiring different freelancers.



???? HOW TO APPLY

Please send me the following:

1. Your portfolio

Send your best short-form video examples.

Talking-head videos, fitness content, ads, direct-response content or similar styles are especially relevant.

2. Your experience

Tell me how long you've been editing and what software you use.

3. Your turnaround time

If I send you a 1–2 minute raw video, how quickly can you normally return the finished edit?

4. Your availability

Tell me what hours you're generally available and how quickly you can respond to messages.



I'm looking for someone who understands editing for retention, not just someone who knows how to use editing software.



I'm looking for someone I can work with long-term, so take a little time with your application and show me what you can do.

title: Compliance & Document Assistant — US Homecare (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
WHO WE ARE



We help small home care agencies in the Midwest stay compliant with state healthcare regulations. Most of these agencies are run by one to three people who are excellent at caring for clients and overwhelmed by the office Work. If they miss a signature, an expired document, or a required training record, they can lose their license. We are the back office that makes sure that never happens while saving them on hours and costs. 



The company is run by a former home care agency owner who grew a previous agency to over 90 members before starting this business. You will work directly with the owner, not through layers of management.



THE ROLE



This is a long-term, part-time position, not a short project and not a one-off gig. It start at around 20-25 hours per week. We are adding new agency clients on an ongoing basis, and this seat is expected to grow into full-time work as that happens. You are one of the first hires, and the role will grow with you.



This is heavy document production work. You will be formatting e-signature templates, prefilling forms, organizing client files, and building/revising checklists. It is detailed, sometimes repetitive, and unforgiving of sloppiness. If you want variety and creativity from day one, this is not the role.



What makes it interesting is what comes after. As you learn the regulations, you take over more of the thinking work: reading a rule, d
 what documents it requires, and building the system that produces them. You will write the SOPs for your own job as you go, to help these struggling Home care agencies. 



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build and format document templates in BoldSign (very similar to DocuSign): field placement, signer roles, naming conventions

- Prefill and prepare client and employee compliance documents from source files

- Organize and audit client and employee files in Dropbox against a compliance checklist

- Read state licensing rules from Department Human services for example provided to you, and learn how the system works

- Track expiring items: background checks, trainings, service agreements, certifications etc.

- Write and maintain the SOP for every process you touch

- Some claims and billing reviewing in a EHR system to make sure the agency is up to date.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



- No client contact. No client calls/emails. Everything routes through the owner.

- No sales, no lead generation, no social media, no cold outreach.



SCHEDULE



- 20-25 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with room to grow into full-time if desired

- Hours are flexible within reason, but the role requires overlap with US Central Time business hours (roughly 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM CDT). In Philippine time, that window is late night into early morning. Please be realistic about what you can sustain long-term.

- You may keep other clients, but not during your committed hours. 

- $300 - $500 USD per month, depending on experience

- Paid twice per month

- Pay increases as you get faster, need less oversight, and take on more responsibilities, and increases again as hours grow toward full-time. This is not a vague promise; it is how the role is designed. Additional benefits are discussed after probation period.



WHO I AM ACTUALLY LOOKING FOR



No prior knowledge of specific US or Midwest healthcare regulation is required. I provide the source material and the detail. Most applicants have little to not experience with a state licensing rule, and that is fine.



What I cannot train is this: I need someone who can be handed a regulation they have never seen and come back with a working checklist and a list of smart questions, without being walked through it step by step.



Beyond that, I am looking for someone genuinely curious. This role has autonomy, and autonomy only works if you use it. That means:



- Asking questions when something does not make sense, instead of guessing or stalling

- Noticing when a process is inefficient and telling me, rather than doing it the slow way forever

- Bringing ideas and suggestions, not just completed tasks

- Learning on your own between tasks instead of waiting for the next instruction 



If you need every step explained twice, this will not work. If you enjoy taking something confusing and making it orderly, you will do well here.



You also need:



- Excellent written English. You will write checklists and SOPs that will be relied on.

- Genuine attention to detail. One missing signature is a real problem for a real business.

- Reliability. If you say something is done, it is done and it is correct.



BACKGROUNDS THAT TRANSLATE WELL



Paralegal, audit, quality assurance, healthcare administration, medical billing, insurance, accounting, public health, or any office admin role where you managed compliance documents or licensing paperwork.



Helpful but not mandatory: BoldSign, DocuSign, PandaDoc, JotForm, Google Workspace, Dropbox, Notion, any US EHR system, or previous work supporting a US home care or home health agency.



CONFIDENTIALITY



You will handle protected health information covered by US HIPAA regulations, and you will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement. This means a private, secure workspace, not a shared computer and not a public network.



GROWTH



We are adding new agency clients on an ongoing basis, and this seat is the foundation of the delivery team. The person in this role is expected to move into a senior position, owning processes, assisting new hires, and reviewing their work, as we grow. Hours and pay increase along the way.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic cover letter. Reply and answer all nine questions below, numbered, in the body of your application. Applications that skip questions will not be reviewed. Also Put the word "Compliance office assistant" in your subject line or application title



1. List the specific hours you can reliably work each weekday, stated in US Central Time. Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet space with no background noise for meetings, a good working computer, a good pair of headsets with a clear microphone is a required.



2. Describe the most complicated document, file, or process you have ever been responsible for organizing or cleaning up. What was messy about it, what did you do, and how did you know when it was right?



3. Have you ever had to read a policy, rule, contract, or manual and turn it into something usable, such as a checklist, template, summary, or process? Tell me what it was and how you approached it.



4. Tell me about a time you suggested a better way to do something at work, without being asked. What happened?



5. Which of these have you used, and how much: BoldSign, DocuSign, PandaDoc, JotForm, Google Workspace, Dropbox, Notion, any US EHR or billing system. 



6. Are you currently working with other clients? How many hours per week, and doing what?



7. What is your expected monthly rate for 20-25 hours per week?

title: Earthworks Estimator - Grading, Cut and Fill Take-Off Specialist
description:
Full-time | Monday to Friday, Australian business hours | Long-term | Above market pay



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a full-time role with an established Victorian civil construction contractor. Their work is earthworks, drainage and pavements on subcontract civil packages to head builders, on jobs between roughly AUD 200,000 and AUD 5 million.



Grading and earthworks take-off is the most important task in this role. Everything else sits behind it.



This is a specialist role. We are not looking for a general construction estimator. We are looking for someone whose core skill is earthworks and grading takeoff on civil projects.





BEFORE YOU APPLY, ANSWER THIS TO YOURSELF



On your last earthworks job, what bulking or shrinkage factor did you apply, and why that number? If that question does not have an immediate answer for you, this role is not for you.



Please do not apply if your estimating background is buildings, fit-out, MEP, structural steel or general trade packages. Please do not apply if your earthworks experience is checking or pricing quantities that somebody else measured.





WHAT YOU WOULD DO



- Build cut and fill take-offs from civil drawings

- Measure pavements and stormwater drainage

- Work from geotechnical reports and structural drawings as well as the civil set

- Produce your own working, in a form someone else can audit

- Flag scope gaps, assumptions, exclusions and risk items before a number goes out

- Work to Australian terminology, units and standards





TOOLS AND SOFTWARE



You will be properly equipped. If you need a specific tool to do the work well, tell us in Question 8 and we will sort it out.



What we care about is whether you can build a surface from a drawing, produce a take-off you can stand behind, and know when a number looks wrong.





MUST HAVE



ESSENTIAL: A civil engineering or quantity surveying background, with real experience behind it.



ESSENTIAL: Grading and earthworks take-off experience on civil or infrastructure projects, on real jobs you can describe in detail.



ESSENTIAL: You can read a geotechnical report and price from it.



- Able to read civil drawings and structural drawings

- Experience measuring pavements and stormwater drainage

- Strong Excel

- Fluent in a PDF measurement and mark-up tool

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Available Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Australian Eastern Time

- Reliable internet and a professional home working setup





NICE TO HAVE



- Australian project experience

- Bulk earthworks on subdivisions, land development or road projects

- Experience building surfaces from contours, spot levels or point files

- Experience pricing from first-principles rate libraries, including plant and labour rates





WORK SAMPLES - PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY



We are asking every applicant to attach examples of earthworks and grading take-off work you have actually done. This is the single biggest thing that will get your application looked at.



Send as many of these four as you can. One is better than none. All four will get your application read first.



1. A grading or earthworks take-off spreadsheet showing cut and fill

2. An earthworks heat map, or a cut and fill colour map

3. A pavement take-off mark-up

4. A drainage take-off mark-up



REDACT ANYTHING CONFIDENTIAL. 





WHAT IS ON OFFER



- Above market rate pay

- Full-time and long-term with one client, not project-by-project gig work

- Supported by a dedicated manager whose role is to help you succeed

- Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Australian Eastern Time. (with some variations by agreement)

- Ongoing salary reviews





HOW TO APPLY



Submit your updated resume, attach your work samples, and answer every question below.



ATTENTION: you must directly answer these questions in your application to be considered. Applications without answers will not be read.





1. List the files you have attached and what each one is. If you have attached nothing, write NONE.



2. Name two earthworks jobs you took off. For each one: the project type, the approximate cut and fill volumes, whether the site balanced, and what you did with the surplus or the shortfall.



3. A car park levels plan gives you finished surface levels. The pavement build-up is 40mm asphalt on 100mm Class 3 on 200mm Class 4. Landscape areas get 100mm of topsoil. You have already built the existing surface from the feature survey. What surface do you difference against to get the bulk earthworks cut and fill, and how do you build it?



4. Show your arithmetic on this one. Cut is 8,000 cubic metres and fill is 8,000 cubic metres, measured between surfaces. The geotechnical report gives a bulking factor of 25% and a compaction factor of 10% for the site clay. Does the site balance? What do you order in, and what do you cart away?



5. A geotechnical report tells you: uncontrolled fill to 0.8m, stiff clay below, groundwater at 2.6m, refusal at 3.2m, and rock in one borehole only at 2.9m. The structural drawings show a basement pad requiring excavation to 1.5m across the footprint. What do you price differently because of that report, and what do you write as an exclusion or an assumption when the number goes out?



6. A 180m run of DN450 Class 3 concrete pipe falls from 1.2m to 4.1m of cover across five pits. How do you measure and structure this for pricing, and what quantities besides the pipe itself do you produce?



7. Which earthworks quantities end up in a contract but do not appear as a line or a level on the civil drawings? Where do you find them? If you have worked to Australian standards or specifications, name one and one thing it required that changed your quantities.



8. What software do you use, and what would you want us to provide? Say roughly how many years on each. If there is a tool you work best in that you do not currently have access to, name it.



9. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP, what hours do you work right now, and when could you start?
salary: Above market rates based on experience

title: Finance & Operations Coordinator — Remote (Day Shift)
description:
Finance & Operations Coordinator — Remote (Day Shift)



TYPE OF WORK: Bookkeeping, Finance, Operations

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

JOB CATEGORY: Finance & Accounting

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-Time

SALARY: $1,200–$1,400/month



JOB DESCRIPTION



We are a leading U.S.-based communications firm serving mission-driven organizations — schools, healthcare organizations, nonprofits, advocacy groups, campaigns, and civic institutions. We help our clients build visibility, public trust, and real momentum through strategy, creative, advertising, and outreach. We also manage our own portfolio of properties that generate recurring revenue and fund our operations.



We run a lean, AI-enabled operation and are growing fast. We need a sharp Finance & Operations Coordinator to own the money side end to end — someone who manages client invoicing, subcontractor payments, vendor costs, and keeps the books current. You'll work directly with the founder on cash management and directly with vendors and customers. This is the financial operations backbone of a growing firm and multi-property real estate business with recurring client contracts and active freelance talent. One big project: in December, you'll catch up eight months of backlogged bookkeeping during the quieter month.



Schedule: Three daytime Philippine options: 4AM–1PM PHT, 6AM–3PM PHT, or 7AM–4PM PHT. You'll have a twice-weekly check-in with the founder in PT (typically brief, structured, 15–20 minutes).



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Client Invoicing & Receivables

- Implement contract-to-cash: watch for fully executed contracts, draft the first invoice, and send it immediately

- Create and send recurring monthly invoices to clients

- Track what's paid, what's outstanding, and when to follow up

- Enforce payment terms (typically: invoice on delivery, payment due in 30 days)

- Keep AR aging clean and flag slow payers



Subcontractor Payments & Communication

- Review freelancer and vendor invoices for accuracy and rate verification

- Compile invoices into payment batches

- Log payment history and match to contracts

- Communicate with subcontractors about invoice status and timing

- Flag rate anomalies or scope creep

- Confirm a completed W-9 is on file before approving any first-time contractor invoice

- Track which vendors/subcontractors are approaching the $
reporting threshold and flag for year-end 1099 prep



Vendor Cost Management

- Build and maintain a directory of vendors (contractors, service providers, tool subscriptions)

- Document cost per item or rate per hour

- Run a quarterly rate audit: confirm we're getting competitive pricing

- Flag subscriptions that should be cancelled or renegotiated

- Present vendor cost trends in weekly and monthly reporting



Bookkeeping & Monthly Close

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payments (AP/AR)

- Categorize transactions into the chart of accounts

- Handle month-end reconciliation and close

- Use QuickBooks Online as your system of record

- December project: catch up eight months of backlogged entries and reconciliation



Cash Flow & Reporting

- Analyze cash flow weekly: money in, money out, runway, timing mismatches

- Prepare a weekly cash flow summary for the founder

- Monthly: produce a financial package (cash position, receivables aging, vendor summary, budget variance)

- Track and forecast based on contract pipeline and known expenses



Compliance Calendar

- Maintain a calendar of key annual deadlines (business registration renewals, 1099 filings, insurance renewals, and other regulatory dates)

- Set reminders at 60, 30, 14, and 7 days out from each deadline

- Alert the founder as deadlines approach so decisions can be made on time



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Experience:

- Accounting degree or equivalent background in accounting/bookkeeping

- 3+ years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience

- Comfortable owning reconciliation and month-end close

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software



Core Skills:

- Exceptional written English (client-facing invoices and correspondence)

- Proficiency in Google Sheets, Notion, Slack, and Gmail

- Ability to organize and track dozens of small transactions and vendor relationships

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers



Mindset:

- Self-directed: you manage your own calendar, priorities, and handoff

- Proactive problem-finder: you flag issues before they become problems

- High integrity: you handle financial data and payments with absolute confidentiality and precision

- Collaborative: you're comfortable working with the founder and occasional freelancers



Nice-to-haves:

- Familiarity with contract-to-cash workflows

- Vendor rate negotiation experience



WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

- Clear ownership: You own financial operations end-to-end, not just data entry

- Strategic visibility: Weekly one-on-ones with the founder mean you see the bigger picture

- Fast learning curve: You'll touch invoicing, AR, AP, reconciliation, cash flow, and vendor management—not a siloed task

- Flexible schedule: Choose your preferred daytime PHT window; asynchronous by default

- Professional growth: You'll learn how a real business manages cash and vendor relationships

- Stability: Full-time role with consistent founder check-ins and clear priorities

- Remote-friendly: Structured touchpoints only, no meeting hell

- Impact: Your work directly affects cash flow and keeps operations running



HOW TO APPLY



1. Fill out the intake form at: 

2. Reply with:

   - Your resume (or work history summary)

   - A note about why you're interested in this role

   - Your preferred schedule (which PHT window works best?)



We review applications as they come in and move quickly for strong fits.



TAGS / KEYWORDS



Bookkeeping, Finance Operations, Accounting, QuickBooks Online, Invoicing, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Reconciliation, Cash Flow Analysis, Vendor Management, Month-End Close, Contract Management, Financial Reporting, Remote Philippines, Day Shift, Full-Time, Operations Coordinator, Notion, Google Sheets, Freelancer Management, Small Business Finance

title: Project Manager/Ops Coordinator
description:
1. VISION & OPPORTUNITY 

Kipkeh Media is a high-impact US media network expanding its core operational engine. As our content volume rapidly grows across vlogs, local business promotions, and community feature spots, we need an agile, highly adaptable remote Project Manager / Operations Coordinator. We are not looking for rigid operators; we need an adaptable problem-solver who thrives in a fast-moving environment, adjusts seamlessly on the fly, and brings structure, speed, and steady execution to evolving media workflows.

2. ROLE OVERVIEW

This role focuses on flexible project management and cross-functional coordination. You will serve as the central operational bridge connecting on-the-ground field creators (vloggers and hosts), remote intake specialists, and post-production video editors. In an environment where creative direction and publishing schedules naturally shift, your primary mission is to adapt quickly, review raw assets, keep context flowing, and move content smoothly from raw capture to final publish without friction or bottlenecks.

3. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Agile Pipeline & Delivery Management: Track and oversee the full production lifecycle for Kipkeh Media content (daily vlogs, commercial features, and community spots). Flexibly adapt to shifting production priorities, rapid turnarounds, and sudden content updates to maintain steady output.

Pre-Edit Raw Media Review & Quality Check: Thoroughly review and audit all incoming raw video files before handing them off to video editors. Categorize footage, verify audio/visual quality, identify key highlights, and outline clear editing notes on what to cut, keep, or enhance. Adaptably manage production workflows for local business promotions, paid interviews.

Dynamic Cross-Team Alignment: Conduct daily check-ins across field creators, intake specialists, and editors. Keep all moving parts synchronized, clear on daily priorities, and accountable to publishing schedules.

Evolving Systems & SOP Optimization: Maintain organized multiple trackers using google workspace, tracking dashboards and continuously refine standard operating procedures (SOPs) as our workflows and team scale.

4. THE STANDARD OF EXCELLENCE (REQUIREMENTS)

Project Management Background: 2+ years of experience as an Operations Coordinator, Project Manager, or Content Workflow Manager in digital media, marketing, or agency environments.

Core Adaptability & Growth Mindset: Exceptional flexibility. You handle changing daily priorities with composure, proactive and learn new workflows rapidly.

Content Intuition & Attention to Detail: Sharp eye for reviewing raw media assets, spotting compelling promotional moments, and catching missing details before post-production starts.

Cross-Cultural Workflow Comfort: Comfortable organizing video files that feature non-English or niche community dialects.

Clear & Confident Communication: Advanced written and verbal English skills to articulate creative briefs, manage team workflows, and collaborate smoothly with US leadership.

Technical Proficiency: Hands-on proficiency with Google Workspace (Sheets tracking, Docs), Slack, and modern project management tools.

5. COMPENSATION & CAREER GROWTH

Hourly Rate: $5.00 – $6.50 USD per hour (negotiable based on elite project management and process coordination skills).

Adaptive Schedule & Stability: 40 hours per week with flexible scheduling built around core US sync windows, project milestones, and editorial deadlines.

Payment Rails: Weekly payment delivery via Wise.

Dynamic Career Path: Ground-floor opportunity for rapid upward mobility to operational leadership as our media network expands.

title: Ecom Performance Video Editor
description:
We are 7 Figure Brand which is looking for a D2C Supplement Brand Video Editor looking to join our team! As our video editing specialist, you will be responsible for editing high-converting UGC ads, direct response video creatives,VSL’s and psychology-based video content to be used across paid marketing channels (primarily Meta).



We are looking to hire someone with 1.5+ years of ecommerce work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience editing paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC content,VSL’s direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with supplement/health brands.



#Note#

- Don't apply if you can't do a small trial video for us.

- You will be prioritised if you send a curated drive portfolio. (It should include 5 videos showing your best work. Make sure to include AI videos as well.)



Key Objectives:



-Edit 1-15 high-converting video ads per week from raw UGC footage and stock content

-Transform raw creator footage into polished, direct response ads optimized for Meta platforms

-Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics (CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate) through superior editing

-Create multiple variations and iterations of winning ad concepts quickly

-Use data from creative performance on Meta to analyze what editing techniques, hooks, and structures are driving results

-Work with our creative strategist to bring scripts and concepts to life through compelling editing

-Maintain organized asset libraries and editing workflows for maximum efficiency

-Provide quick turnaround times on revisions and new edits to support rapid testing cycles



Requirements:



-Fully remote

-Fluent in English

-Direct Response Editing Expertise: 1.5+ Years experience editing performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must

-Software Proficiency: Expert-level skills in Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects or CapCut, Heygen, Veo 3, Higgfield is a must and familiarity with DaVinci Resolve. Mobile editing experience (CapCut mobile) is a plus

-UGC Editing: Extensive experience editing raw UGC footage into high-converting paid ads with native platform aesthetics

-Fast & Efficient: Ability to produce high-quality edits quickly without sacrificing performance. Speed is critical

-Creative & Data-Driven: Understanding of what makes ads perform (hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, effects) and ability to analyze performance data to inform editing decisions

-Portfolio Required: Must provide portfolio showcasing DTC video ads (preferably supplements, health, or e-commerce)

-No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work

-Excellent cultural fit as per our values above

-Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders

-Understanding of direct response principles and how editing impacts conversion

-Include word "Guava" in your application to prove your legit. Include the word in the title.

- Your application won't be considered if it doesn't include the word as the title.



Accountabilities:



-Edit 10-20 video ads per week from provided scripts, raw footage, and assets

-Create multiple variations of winning ads (different hooks, text overlays, pacing)

-Add compelling captions, text overlays, sound effects, and visual effects that enhance performance

-Maintain consistent turnaround times (24-48 hours for standard edits, same-day for urgent)

-Organize and manage all video assets, footage libraries, and project files

-Collaborate with creative strategist to understand video concepts and execute the vision

Source and integrate b-roll, stock footage, and motion graphics as needed

-Adapt editing style to emerging trends and platform best practices

-Review performance data on edited ads and identify patterns in what's working

-Iterate quickly on underperforming ads and create new versions based on data insights

-Create editing templates and systems to increase output efficiency

-Maintain brand consistency across all video content while optimizing for performance



How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate:



When hiring, we'll work with you to define the KPIs you'll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you're doing a good job after you start.



Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project (edit 2-3 ads from provided footage), and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.



For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

title: PERFORMANCE MARKETER — PAID TRIAL, THEN ONGOING
description:
We run a real estate education brand that teaches first-generation buyers how to purchase their first property. Our organic reach works. Our paid acquisition does not exist yet.



**Current state, stated plainly so you can d
 if this is your kind of problem:**



- 14,000 organic views per week across Instagram and YouTube

- One
 opt-in from that traffic in the last seven days

- A free weekly live session that converts well once people attend

- A four-tier membership from $47 to $997 per month

- A free lead magnet and a 30-day nurture sequence



**The gap is conversion, not attention.** We do not need someone to make us go viral. We need someone who can turn attention into opt-ins, opt-ins into attendance, and attendance into paid members.



---



## WHAT YOU WOULD OWN



- Paid acquisition on Meta and YouTube, end to end

- Landing page and funnel conversion rate, not just click cost

- Creative testing against a defined belief, not random variations

- Weekly reporting on cost per opt-in, cost per room attendee, and cost per member



---



## HOW WE HIRE



**We do not hire from a portfolio. We hire from a paid trial.**



**Step one.** Send your three best results with real numbers. Spend, cost per acquisition, and what the business actually made. Screenshots from ad manager, not a case study PDF. If you cannot show numbers, we are not the right fit.



**Step two.** Paid trial. We give you a defined budget, our creative library, and our offer. You build and run the campaign for two weeks.



**Step three.** We hire whoever wins on this metric and only this metric:



> **Cost per booked conversation.**



Not impressions. Not reach. Not click-through rate. **How many real people ended up in a real conversation, and what did each one cost.**



Whoever wins the trial gets the ongoing role.



---



## COMPENSATION



Paid trial at a flat rate, agreed before you start.



Ongoing role is base plus performance. **For the right person who wins the trial and wants long-term upside, we are open to a profit share conversation.** That conversation happens after the trial, in writing, with an attorney involved. We are not offering equity in a job post and you should be suspicious of anyone who does.



---



## WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



- Anyone whose case studies have no numbers in them

- Anyone who wants to rebuild the brand before running a single test

- Anyone who reports on reach and engagement instead of cost per acquisition

- Agencies subcontracting the work to someone we never speak to



---



## WHO THIS IS FOR



Someone who has spent real money on someone else's behalf, kept a record of what it returned, and can tell me about a campaign that failed and what they learned from it.



If that is you, lead your application with the number you are proudest of and the number you are least proud of.



Applications only through this form. Do not message me directly:

We need someone who understands how to build a professional, trustworthy and **conversion-focused fashion store** — from the overall Shopify theme and product-page structure to product imagery, copywriting, sizing information, bundles, social proof and CRO elements.



## What You'll Be Doing



You will help build and optimize our Shopify store from the ground up.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Building and customizing Shopify stores from scratch

* Creating clean, professional women's fashion storefronts for European customers

* Building homepage, collection, product and supporting pages

* Creating a **high-quality reusable product page template** that can easily be plugged into new products

* Designing product pages specifically for **conversion rate optimization**

* Importing and building products using **POKY and KOPY**

* Using **Claude and ChatGPT** for product copy, research and workflow assistance

* Using **Higgsfield** to create and improve high-quality fashion product imagery and creative assets

* Selecting, editing and organizing professional product images

* Making sure AI-generated imagery looks realistic, consistent and appropriate for a legitimate fashion brand

* Writing and improving product titles, descriptions, benefits and selling points

* Creating accurate, easy-to-understand **size charts**

* Creating product variants, pricing, SKUs and other product information

* Building product bundles, quantity offers and upsells

* Adding social proof and trust-building elements

* Creating clean collection pages and organizing navigation

* Optimizing the mobile shopping experience

* Maintaining consistent branding, typography, spacing and imagery throughout the store

* Quality-checking the entire storefront before launch



## Product Page & CRO Expectations



We do not want generic Shopify product pages.



Every important product page should feel like it belongs to an established women's fashion brand and should be designed to make the purchasing decision as easy as possible.



You should understand how to properly structure elements such as:



* Strong product imagery

* Clear product titles

* Pricing and promotional offers

* Variant and size selectors

* Size guides

* Product benefits and descriptions

* Fit and sizing information

* Material and care information

* Shipping and returns information

* Trust elements

* Customer reviews and social proof

* Product bundles

* Quantity offers

* Cross-sells and complementary products

* Frequently bought together sections

* FAQ sections

* Clear calls to action

* Sticky Add to Cart where appropriate

* Mobile-first layouts



You should understand **why these elements improve conversions**, rather than simply adding them because you were told to.



## Reusable Product Template



One of the most important parts of this position is creating an excellent **plug-and-play product template**.



Once the initial store and system are built, we want to be able to add new women's fashion products quickly without rebuilding every page from scratch.



The template should maintain consistent:



* Layout

* Branding

* Typography

* Product imagery standards

* Size-chart formatting

* Product descriptions

* Social proof

* Trust elements

* Bundles and offers

* CRO sections

* Mobile formatting



The goal is to create a scalable system where new products can be added quickly while still maintaining a high-quality storefront.



## Tools You Must Be Comfortable With



Strong experience with the following is highly preferred:



**Shopify** – Store building, themes, product templates, collections, navigation and product management



**POKY** – Product importing and product workflow



**KOPY** – Product copy and listing optimization



**ChatGPT** – Copywriting, research and workflow assistance



**Claude** – Copywriting, research and workflow assistance



**Higgsfield** – Creating high-quality AI fashion/product imagery and creative assets



Experience with additional Shopify CRO, review, bundle, upsell or page-building apps is a strong plus.



## What We're Looking For



You must have:



* Previous experience building Shopify stores from scratch

* Proven experience working with a **fashion or apparel brand**

* A portfolio of Shopify stores or product pages you have personally worked on for fashion brands

* Strong understanding of Shopify product-page CRO

* Strong eye for visual design

* Ability to recognize the difference between a generic dropshipping store and a polished fashion brand

* Experience creating reusable Shopify product templates

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to create high-quality product imagery

* Ability to use AI tools effectively without producing generic-looking AI content

* Understanding of women's fashion sizing and size-chart presentation

* Good written English

* Ability to work independently after onboarding

* Ability to follow an existing brand style while also making intelligent improvements



Experience with visually driven e-commerce brands is a strong plus. Knowledge of European e-commerce and women's fashion customers is also highly preferred.



## Quality Standard



We care much more about **quality and attention to detail than simply completing tasks quickly**.



The finished store should look like a real European women's fashion brand — not a quickly assembled dropshipping website.



We expect you to notice things like inconsistent image ratios, poor spacing, awkward copy, incorrect size charts, weak product images, inconsistent fonts, unnecessary sections, poor mobile formatting and anything else that reduces trust or conversion rate.



You should be the type of person who notices these problems without needing us to point out every single one.



## About the Role



This is intended to become a long-term position for the right person.



The initial phase will focus heavily on **building the Shopify store, establishing our design standards and creating the reusable product-page system**.



Once the store structure and templates are established, the role will expand into launching products, improving existing pages, testing new offers and continuously improving the storefront.



We want someone who can eventually take ownership of the Shopify storefront rather than requiring step-by-step instructions for every task.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Links to **2–5 Shopify stores for fashion or apparel brands** you have personally worked on.

2. Examples of fashion product pages you built or optimized.

3. Briefly explain exactly what you did on each store you send us.

4. Tell us about your experience working directly with fashion or apparel brands.

5. Tell us which of these tools you have experience with: **POKY, KOPY, ChatGPT, Claude and Higgsfield.**

6. Tell us about any Shopify CRO, bundle, upsell or review apps you have experience using.

7. Send an example of what you consider a **high-converting women's fashion product page** and briefly explain why you think it converts well.



Please do not send stores you did not personally work on.



**Start your application with the word "VELVET"** so we know you read the entire job posting.



Applications without VELVET at the beginning will not be considered.

title: Senior Bookkeeper - AP/AR, Finance Operations (Agency + Ecom)
description:
Wavy Studios is marketing agency who does client work and builds our own in-house brands (ecommerce/service based). We've grown to the point where our finances and internal operations are held together by the founder's evenings, and that's not a plan. We're hiring the person who takes it over properly.



This is a broad, foundational role. You'll own the books end to end, make sure money we've earned actually arrives, and bring order to the administrative machinery of a growing studio. 



What you'll own

(1) The books. Day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations across banks, cards and payment processors, and a monthly close on a fixed calendar.

(2) Receivables. Invoicing on time and against contract terms, and chasing what's overdue

(3) Payables. Supplier and freelancer bills checked against what was approved and what was delivered, then paid in clean weekly runs.

(4) Reporting. A monthly management pack with real commentary, a rolling 13-week cash forecast, and project-level profitability so we know which work is worth doing. 

(5) Client and vendor admin. Contracts and SOWs out and signed, deposits and stage payments tracked, retainer renewals surfaced early, freelancer rates and approvals kept tidy.

(6) Studio operations. Our tool stack and seats, joiner and leaver checklists, contractor paperwork, subscription audits, and the process docs that stop knowledge living in one person's head.

(7) Our external partners. Day-to-day relationship with our accountant and payroll provider, and the year-end pack that keeps them efficient.



What we need

Several years running full-cycle bookkeeping for a business, closing months without supervision

Strong QuickBooks Online experience - comfortable with chart of accounts structure, project tracking and bank rules, not just entry

Real reconciliation experience, including payment processors, transfers and the awkward cases

A track record of collecting overdue invoices without damaging relationships

Solid spreadsheets: pivots, lookups, and building a cash-flow model from scratch

Clear, warm writing — you'll be the voice of a lot of our administrative

Genuine discretion. You'll see everything.
