title: Customer Success Manager | SEO & AI Search (AEO/GEO)
description:
We are looking for a highly organized, proactive **Customer Success Manager** to join Summit Search, an AI Search and SEO agency helping businesses improve their visibility across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI search platforms.



This is not a basic customer support role.



You will **own the client relationship from onboarding through launch and ongoing delivery**. Your job is to make sure clients move through our process quickly, understand what we're doing, provide everything our team needs, and receive a great experience.



### What You'll Be Responsible For

* Manage client communication through Slack, calls,
, and our project management systems

* Own new client onboarding from start to finish

* Collect website, domain, Google, analytics, and other required access

* Follow up with clients until everything required for launch is received

* Coordinate with our website and fulfillment team to keep projects moving

* Stay on top of team members and make sure deliverables are completed correctly and on time

* Help clients understand why certain website or SEO changes are recommended

* Communicate technical concepts in simple language clients can understand

* Keep clients updated without them needing to chase us

* Identify blockers and solve them proactively

* Monitor account progress and identify clients who may be at risk of cancelling

* Help keep client churn as low as possible

* Assist with weekly checks and audits of client websites, Google Business Profiles, Google Analytics, SEO performance, and AI search visibility

* Develop a strong understanding of each client's business, product, target market, competitors, and goals



### Your Main Goal

Our target is to get new clients fully launched as quickly as possible, ideally **within 10 days of onboarding**.



You will be responsible for making sure nothing sits idle because a client hasn't responded, access hasn't been provided, or an internal team member hasn't completed something.



You should naturally think:

**"What needs to happen next to move this client forward?"**



And then make it happen.



### What We're Looking For



You should have:

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong client communication skills

* Previous experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Project Management, SEO, or a digital marketing agency

* Strong organization and attention to detail

* The ability to manage several clients at the same time

* A very proactive personality

* Strong follow-up skills

* The confidence to speak with business owners and founders on calls

* The ability to explain complicated concepts simply

* The ability to work independently without constant supervision

* A high level of ownership and accountability



### Strongly Preferred



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:

* SEO

* AEO / GEO / AI Search Optimization

* Google Business Profile

* Google Analytics

* Google Search Console

* GoHighLevel

* WordPress or website management

* Website migrations

* ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or other AI tools

* Slack

* ClickUp

* Digital marketing agencies



You do **not** need to be an advanced SEO strategist or developer.



We already have people responsible for technical fulfillment.



However, you need enough understanding of SEO, websites, and AI search to confidently communicate with clients, identify when something isn't being done correctly, and keep the delivery team accountable.



### Who Will Do Well In This Role

You will do well if you're the type of person who:

* Follows up without being asked

* Notices when something isn't moving

* Doesn't wait around for someone else to solve problems

* Takes client results personally

* Is comfortable holding team members accountable

* Can build trust with clients

* Learns software quickly

* Is resourceful when you don't immediately know the answer

* Likes having ownership rather than simply completing assigned tasks



If your default response to a problem is **"I'll figure it out"**, you'll probably fit well here.



### About Summit Search

Summit Search helps businesses become more visible across both traditional search engines and AI search platforms.



Our team handles SEO, AEO, GEO, website optimization, content, technical improvements, AI visibility, and other strategies designed to help businesses get discovered when customers search on Google or ask tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity for recommendations.



We're growing quickly and are looking for someone who can eventually take complete ownership of the customer success side of the business.

title: Finance Manager
description:
CONTROLLER / SENIOR FINANCE & ACCOUNTING MANAGER 



Southern Domestic Diva 



Southern Domestic Diva is seeking an experienced, highly analytical Controller / Senior Finance & Accounting Manager to take ownership of the financial operations of a growing, multi-entity service company. This is not a basic bookkeeping or accounting assistant position. We need a proactive financial operator who can protect cash flow, strengthen financial controls, aggressively manage accounts receivable, reduce unnecessary expenses, improve profitability, prevent unnecessary debt, and build scalable systems capable of supporting $4 million+ in annual revenue and continued growth. 



1. XERO & ACCOUNTING MANAGEMENT 



Advanced Xero proficiency is required. Maintain accurate, current books across multiple business entities, bank accounts, credit cards, revenue streams, and service divisions. 



Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, deposits, invoices, and general ledger activity. 



Properly categorize income and expenses and allocate transactions to the correct entity and division. 



Identify, research, and resolve accounting discrepancies without waiting for leadership to discover them. 



Prepare accurate Profit & Loss statements and maintain clean, tax-ready books and supporting documentation. 



Maintain strong internal financial controls and improve accounting processes as the company scales. 



2. ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE & COLLECTIONS 



The AR process is not complete when an invoice is sent. It is complete when the money has been collected, properly recorded, and reconciled. 



Own Accounts Receivable as one of the highest-priority functions of the role. 



Maintain accurate AR aging and continuously review 30/60/90+ day balances. 



Follow up consistently by phone and
; communicate directly with corporate Accounts Payable departments. 



Track promised payment dates, confirm payments arrive, and escalate significantly past-due accounts. 



Resolve invoice discrepancies, PO issues, and client-specific billing requirements that delay payment. 



Develop systems that accelerate collections and provide leadership clear visibility into outstanding AR. 



3. SQUARE & PAYMENT PROCESSOR RECONCILIATION 



Monitor Square payments, settlements, fees, and deposits and match customer payments to invoices and bank deposits. 



Reconcile discrepancies among Square, Xero, company databases, and bank activity, including systems that do not automatically integrate. 



Identify missing, duplicate, incorrect, or unmatched transactions and maintain supporting payment ledgers when necessary. 



Be comfortable adapting to additional or different third-party payment processors. 



4. 13-WEEK CASH-FLOW FORECASTING 



Own and update a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast every week. 



Forecast beginning cash, expected collections, payroll, payroll taxes, bills, operating expenses, debt/financial obligations, planned expenditures, and projected ending cash. 



Compare projected receipts with actual receipts and identify potential cash shortages well before they become emergencies. 



Recommend corrective actions, accelerate critical collections, and help establish appropriate operating reserves. 



5. EXPECTED FUNDS & PAYROLL PLANNING 



Own and improve the company Fund Expectation spreadsheet showing anticipated incoming revenue and outgoing obligations. 



Track expected payment dates, upcoming bills, payroll requirements, payroll taxes, and funds expected during payroll weeks. 



Forecast whether expected cash will adequately cover payroll and other obligations and communicate potential funding gaps early. 



Leadership should always know current available cash, expected incoming cash, bills due, outstanding receivables, and upcoming payroll needs. 



6. DEBT PREVENTION & CASH PROTECTION 



Help the company operate through strong cash-flow management rather than unnecessary borrowing. 



Monitor liabilities and future cash requirements, evaluate the cash impact of major purchases, and present alternatives before financing is considered. 



Monitor interest, financing costs, bank fees, merchant fees, and other drains on cash. 



Develop strategies to improve working capital, strengthen reserves, and reduce reliance on debt. 



7. WEEKLY GROSS & NET PROFITABILITY 



Complete and analyze weekly revenue, gross profit, gross margin, net profit, net margin, direct labor, subcontractor costs, and operating expenses. 



Compare performance week over week and flag low-margin or negative-profit accounts and projects. 



Investigate why profitability changed and recommend corrective action; providing numbers without analysis is not sufficient. 



8. LABOR & CREW-TIME PROFITABILITY 



Work with operations and scheduling to compare scheduled/budgeted labor hours with actual crew hours. 



Monitor labor cost as a percentage of revenue, overtime, inefficient staffing patterns, and recurring jobs that exceed allotted time. 



Analyze labor profitability by client and quantify the financial impact of labor overruns. 



Recommend pricing, staffing, scheduling, or time-limit changes and monitor whether those changes improve profitability. 



9. CLIENT, PROJECT & DIVISION PROFITABILITY 



Analyze profitability by client, project, recurring account, and service division, including residential, vacation rental, commercial, construction, and specialty services. 



Identify highest- and lowest-margin services, underpriced accounts, negative-profit work, labor margins, subcontractor margins, and revenue concentration. 



Make recommendations regarding pricing, labor allocation, service structure, and corrective action. 



10. BILL MANAGEMENT & COST REDUCTION 



Own and maintain an accurate bill spreadsheet, track due dates, and prevent unnecessary late fees. 



Review recurring expenses including software, insurance, telecommunications, banking, merchant processing, vendors, supplies, and administrative costs. 



Identify duplicate or unnecessary expenses, research lower-cost alternatives, compare vendors, and recommend renegotiations. 



Proactively identify ways to save money and track savings actually achieved. Cost reduction is an ongoing responsibility, not an occasional project. 



11. BUDGETING & BUDGET VS. ACTUAL 



Develop monthly operating budgets, realistic revenue expectations, and labor budgets. 



Compare actual performance against budget, investigate significant variances, identify overspending quickly, and recommend corrective actions. 



Update forecasts as business conditions change and help leadership understand the financial impact of hiring, pricing, spending, and expansion decisions. 



12. CEO FINANCIAL DASHBOARD 



Prepare a concise weekly leadership dashboard showing current available cash, expected incoming cash, AR and past-due AR, next payroll requirement, expected payroll-week funding, weekly revenue, gross and net margins, labor percentage, major bills, liabilities, budget variances, cash forecast, financial risks, cost-saving opportunities, and recommended actions. 



Translate the numbers into clear business implications and action items for leadership. 



13. TAX ACCOUNTANT & PROFESSIONAL COORDINATION 



Work directly with the company tax accountant and other financial professionals. 



Keep books tax-ready, prepare requested reports and documentation, resolve discrepancies, support tax planning, and coordinate year-end requirements. 



Serve as the primary internal financial point person between leadership and outside accounting professionals. 



14. FINANCIAL SYSTEMS & SCALABILITY 



Build and improve financial systems, controls, reporting, forecasting, and accountability capable of supporting $4 million+ in annual revenue and continued growth. 



Continually evaluate whether processes can scale, be automated, collect cash faster, reduce costs, improve margins, and reveal financial risk earlier. 



Help leadership see the big picture and make financially sound decisions before problems become emergencies. 



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 



Minimum 5+ years of substantial professional accounting, Controller, senior bookkeeping, or finance-management experience. 



Advanced Xero proficiency and extensive Accounts Receivable/collections experience. 



Strong general ledger, bank, credit-card, and third-party payment-processor reconciliation experience. 



Experience with Square or comparable payment processors and systems that may not integrate directly. 



Cash-flow forecasting, multi-entity accounting, P&L analysis, gross/net profitability analysis, budgeting, and labor-cost analysis. 



Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills and experience building financial models or forecasts. 



Exceptional analytical ability, attention to detail, confidentiality, communication, and independent problem solving. 



HIGHLY PREFERRED 



Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field. 



CPA, CPA candidate, Certified Bookkeeper, Xero certification, or comparable credential. 



Experience managing financial operations for a multi-million-dollar service business. 



Experience with commercial/construction AR, multi-entity accounting, financial rebuilding, cost-reduction initiatives, and rapid growth. 



Experience working directly with CPAs or tax accountants. 



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR 



Analytical. Proactive. Resourceful. Persistent. Extremely organized. Financially disciplined. Cost-conscious. Comfortable challenging expenses. Serious about collecting receivables. Obsessed with accuracy. This person should think like an owner and financial operator, not simply a bookkeeper. 



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

title: Social Media Marketing
description:
# SOCIAL MEDIA & FAN PAGE ASSISTANT



**Remote | Part-Time | ₱10,000 PHP/month | 15 hours/week**



We're looking for someone who is **very online, creative, and understands internet culture** to help grow music through short-form content.



You should genuinely enjoy **K-dramas, anime, memes, edits, movies, and online fan culture.**



## THE GOAL



The strategy is simple:



**Get people to discover songs from different angles.**



Instead of simply posting a song and telling people to listen, we'll use the music in different types of content that people already enjoy watching and sharing.



For example:



* K-drama edits

* Anime edits

* Memes

* Relatable content

* Aesthetic videos

* Movie edits



The goal is for someone to discover the **content first**, and then discover the **song naturally through the content**.



## THE 4 ACCOUNTS



Once fully onboarded, you'll manage **4 separate social media accounts**, each with a completely different content theme.



### 1. K-Drama Edits



Romantic, emotional, funny, or dramatic K-drama scenes using the music.



### 2. Meme / Relatable



Short memes and relatable situations using the music.



The text on screen should be something someone would **actually want to send to a friend**.



### 3. Anime Edits



Emotional, romantic, funny, or cinematic anime scenes using the music.



### 4. Aesthetic



Dreamy, emotional, cinematic, beautiful, or visually interesting content using the music.



**Optional:** If you have a strong idea for a Western movie account, you can propose it as an alternative to one of the above.



**IMPORTANT:** Keep the content completely separate between accounts. Each account should feel like its own page with its own audience and identity.



---



# TRIAL — FIRST WEEK



The first **week is a paid trial**.



During the trial, you will only be responsible for **2 accounts**, rather than all 4.



We'll decide together which two themes to start with based on your strengths.



### Days 1–3



Do not immediately start posting.



Spend the first 3 days naturally using the accounts:



* Scroll through relevant content

* Watch videos in your niche

* Like videos

* Save videos

* Leave genuine comments on relevant videos

* Study which videos perform well

* Study captions and hooks

* Study what people share and engage with

* Learn the culture of each community



The goal is to understand **what already works within each niche**.



You can take inspiration from successful posts and adapt their **caption structures, hooks, formats, and ideas** into original content.



### Days 4–7



Start posting.



**Post once per day on each trial account.**



That's **2 posts per day total** during the trial.



We'll use this week to evaluate your:



* Creativity

* Content instincts

* Editing ability

* Understanding of internet culture

* Understanding of the different niches

* Consistency

* Ability to create content people want to share

* Overall fit



If the trial goes well, you'll move on to managing all **4 accounts**.



---



# POSTING



Once fully onboarded:



**Post once per day on each of the 4 accounts.**



That's **4 posts per day total**.



### K-Drama / Anime / Movie Edits



Videos should generally be:



**10–30 seconds**



Choose scenes that match the emotion, lyrics, or feeling of the song.



### Meme / Relatable



Keep videos:



**Under 10 seconds**



The text should be the main hook.



The goal is to make someone immediately think:



**"This is literally me."**



or



**"I need to send this to someone."**



---



# CROSS-POSTING



After posting on TikTok:



1. Download the video

2. Post it to YouTube Shorts

3. Post it to Instagram Reels



Content can be adapted slightly for each platform when necessary.



**During the trial, focus on TikTok only.**



---



# IMPORTANT — OFFICIAL AUDIO



When posting on TikTok and Instagram, **always use the official song audio when available**.



This allows people to discover the song through the audio and easily add/save it to their music library.



---



# WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You **must understand internet culture**.



We're looking for someone who:



* Loves memes

* Loves K-dramas

* Loves anime

* Enjoys edits

* Understands TikTok culture

* Understands online fandoms

* Knows what makes people share content

* Has a good sense of humor

* Understands current internet language and trends

* Can recognize why a video is performing well

* Is creative and willing to experiment



You don't need to be an expert editor.



**Good content instincts are more important.**



---



# COMPENSATION



**₱10,000 PHP/month**



Approximately **15 hours per week**.



There is also potential for **performance bonuses** when videos perform exceptionally well.



### Performance Bonuses



* **50K views:** ₱100

* **100K views:** ₱200

* **250K views:** ₱500

* **500K views:** ₱1,000

* **1M+ views:** ₱2,000



Only the **highest tier reached** is paid for each individual video.



**Maximum performance bonus: ₱20,000 PHP per month.**



Bonuses are based on organic views on eligible content created as part of this role.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Any fan pages or social media accounts you've managed

3. Examples of edits, TikToks, Reels, memes, or Shorts you've made

4. Your favorite K-drama

5. Your favorite anime

6. **3 examples of content you think would work well with music**

7. Your availability and time zone



We're looking for someone who **loves the internet, understands memes and fandoms, loves K-dramas and anime, and knows how to turn a song into something people actually want to watch and share.**

title: Sourcing Guru — Executive Search Recruiter (Night Shift, US Client)

	•	Strong written English for candidate summaries and messaging

	•	Bonus: exposure to manufacturing, logistics, distribution, or finance recruiting; lead generation experience

Compensation & Growth

I read every application that follows these steps.

The owner sells. The GM runs the crews. Nobody owns the middle - and good people don't always hear back.



That's the gap. You close it.



Put simply, your job is this -

Be the first warm human every lead hears from, and make sure they get to the right person with nothing missing.



You'll respond fast, kindly, and personally. 



You'll offer the free inspection and do your best to get it booked.



If they need something other than that, you'll make it your responsibility to connect them.



Service and warranty calls go to the GM with everything he needs - so he never has to ask twice. 



Sales conversations go to the owner the same way.



You'll keep the record true in the CRM (HighLevel). Your goal: If it happened, it's in there.



And a few times a shift, you'll send an update on what you've done, and what's next.



Not the job: selling, answering technical questions, building automations.



You won't be on an island. 



Two people will be hands-on with you from day one - and the answers, the access, the context are all there when you ask.



The Offer



Small team. Real stakes. An owner and a GM who just asked for this role to exist.



Your work will be visible. 



Each booked inspection that turns into a job has a significant impact on the company - and everyone here knows it.



We're offering a real team of honest, well meaning guys that wants what you naturally do.



Details



Full time. $6/hour. US Central business hours. 



You'll report to the GM (in Nashville) 



I (David, located in Mindanao) will help you get set up, situated, and find success in this role.



GHL experience helps. Any real CRM background works. We hire character and train skill.



What can't be taught is HOW YOU'RE WIRED.



One thing we're plain about: on the clock means online and available. Every paid hour.



We're hoping you take a personal interest in the success of the company and its team members.



To Apply



Interested?



Tell us about a time someone was waiting on an answer, and YOU were the reason they got one.



Keep it to one paragraph. 



In the same message, tell us the hours (Central time) you can be online and reachable.



IMPORTANT: Your verbal English skills are crucial - the less accent you have, the better. We don't want the callers to ever doubt or question whether you could be their next door neighbor.



If I like your answers to the questions, I'll follow up asking for a quick selfie video :)



In Closing



If you need to be chased, this isn't it.



If the "Details" section read like common sense to you - let's talk.

title: CEO Executive Assistant
description:
Virtual Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff (Remote)

Company: Cornbread Hemp

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Reports to: CEO

Type: Full-time, remote contractor/employee



About Cornbread Hemp

Cornbread Hemp is a Louisville, Kentucky-based, USDA Certified Organic hemp and consumer goods company scaling from ~$50M toward $200M+ in revenue. Our portfolio spans full-spectrum CBD products, THC seltzers, a functional non-alcoholic beverage brand, and mushroom gummies, sold direct-to-consumer and through healthcare, natural, and beverage retail channels. We operate under EOS with a ~105-person team and our own manufacturing facility.



About the Role

We’re looking for a highly organized, proactive Virtual Executive Assistant to serve as a remote Chief of Staff to our CEO. This is not a traditional scheduling-only EA role — you will be the CEO’s right hand in driving multiple concurrent projects to completion, managing follow-through across departments, and keeping priorities visible and on track. You’ll need to operate with significant autonomy, strong judgment, and the ability to synthesize information from many sources into clear next steps.



The ideal candidate has prior experience directly supporting a CEO or senior executive at a consumer goods company, understands the pace and cross-functional nature of that environment (marketing, ops, sales, supply chain, finance), and is comfortable managing ambiguity.



Key Responsibilities

 • Project push-forward: Track the CEO’s active projects and initiatives across departments (marketing, ops, sales, product, finance); proactively follow up with stakeholders to keep things moving and flag what’s stalled

 • Calendar & inbox management: Own the CEO’s calendar, schedule and prioritize meetings across time zones, and triage
/Slack for what needs the CEO’s direct attention vs. what can be delegated or handled independently

 • Meeting support: Prepare agendas and pre-reads, take notes, track action items, and follow up to ensure commitments are completed

 • Communication drafting: Draft
s, Slack messages, memos, and internal comms on the CEO’s behalf in the right tone

 • Research & briefing: Pull together background research, competitive intelligence, or data summaries to support decisions

 • Travel coordination: Plan and book travel logistics as needed

 • Documentation & systems: Maintain trackers/dashboards (e.g., in 
, Google Sheets, or similar) for project status, deadlines, and open items

 • Gatekeeping & prioritization: Help the CEO focus by managing competing demands on their time and pushing back diplomatically when needed

 • Personal/admin tasks: Occasional light personal task support as needed

Required Qualifications

 • 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, or similar role directly supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive

 • Prior experience at a consumer goods (CPG) company — understands the operating rhythm of a CPG business (marketing calendars, retail/DTC channels, supply chain considerations)

 • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

 • Strong project management instincts — able to track multiple workstreams without dropping details

 • High degree of discretion; comfortable handling confidential/sensitive information

 • Proficiency with tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, 
/Asana/ClickUp (or similar), and calendar management tools

 • Able to overlap meaningfully with U.S. Eastern Time working hours

 • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup

Preferred Qualifications

 • Experience supporting a CEO through a period of company scaling/growth

 • Familiarity with EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) or similar operating frameworks

 • Experience with e-commerce/DTC brands and/or wellness, hemp, or beverage industries

 • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate research, drafting, and organization

What Success Looks Like

 • The CEO’s priority projects move forward week over week without the CEO having to personally chase every stakeholder

 • Nothing important falls through the cracks — commitments made in meetings get tracked and closed out

 • The CEO’s calendar and inbox reflect true priorities, not just whoever asked most recently

 • The CEO trusts you to represent them accurately in written communication

title: Reverse Recruiter / U.S. Remote Job Search Specialist
description:
I’m looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Reverse Recruiter / Job Search Assistant to help me secure my next remote professional opportunity with a U.S.-based employer.



I am a U.S. Navy veteran and cleared intelligence professional with 10+ years of experience supporting federal law enforcement, defense, counterintelligence, OSINT, investigative analysis, technical writing, and national-security missions. I currently hold an active TS/SCI clearance with CI Polygraph.



My goal is to build a strong pipeline quickly, so I am looking for someone who can move with urgency, stay organized, and consistently identify and apply to strong opportunities on my behalf.



This is a short-term, results-focused project. I already have a professionally written resume, so I am not looking for someone to rewrite my resume for every position or simply send me random job links. I need someone who can actively manage the search process, identify positions that align with my experience, submit quality applications, and identify the right people for me to personally contact after applying.



Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

*Searching daily across LinkedIn, Indeed, ClearanceJobs, company career pages, and other reputable job boards.

*Reviewing job descriptions carefully before applying.

*Identifying positions that are a realistic match for my background and career level.

*Submitting applications on my behalf using my approved resume and information.

*Completing application questions accurately and professionally.

*Avoiding duplicate applications.

*Prioritizing newer job postings whenever possible.

*Maintaining a detailed job-search tracker.

*For strong opportunities, identifying at least one relevant recruiter, hiring manager, or decision-maker I can personally contact after applying.

*Providing the person’s name, title, LinkedIn profile, and any publicly available professional contact information.

*Flagging particularly strong opportunities immediately so I can personally handle outreach.

*Target Positions



The search should primarily focus on positions such as:

*Analyst

*Intelligence Analyst

*OSINT Analyst

*Threat Intelligence Analyst

*Investigative Analyst

*Program Analyst

*Operations Analyst

*Technical Writer

*Customer Success Manager

*Technical Customer Success Manager

*Technical Account Manager

*Federal / Public Sector Customer Success

*Defense Technology / SaaS roles

*Other similar remote positions where my experience is a strong match



I am especially interested in defense, cybersecurity, intelligence, government contracting, SaaS, AI, and federal technology companies.



I may provide additional job titles or search parameters throughout the project.



Location

*I am looking for remote work with U.S.-based employers.

*I currently spend time between the Philippines and the United States, so U.S.-remote positions should not automatically be excluded. 

*Roles requiring U.S. residency, occasional U.S. travel, or eventual return to the U.S. may still be appropriate.



Quality Over Random Volume

*I am looking for consistent application volume, but I do not want hundreds of random applications submitted simply to meet a quota. Every application should make sense.



For the right candidate, I would expect approximately 15–120 strong applications per business day when enough qualified opportunities are available. The objective is not simply to submit applications. The objective is to build a strong pipeline that produces conversations, interviews, and ultimately an offer.



*You will not communicate with employers pretending to be me.



I will personally handle:

*Recruiter conversations

*LinkedIn networking messages

*Interviews

*Interview scheduling

*Salary negotiations

*Offer discussions



Your role is to build and manage the pipeline, identify the right people for me to contact, and give me the information I need to handle the relationship-building side of the search.



Ideal Candidate

You may be a strong fit if you:



*Have experience with recruiting, sourcing, job searching, virtual assistance, or talent acquisition.

*Understand professional-level U.S. job postings.

*Have experience searching LinkedIn and company career sites.

*Are comfortable researching recruiters and hiring managers.

*Understand how Applicant Tracking Systems work.

*Can quickly evaluate whether someone reasonably matches a job description.

*Have excellent written English.

*Are extremely detail-oriented.

*Can work independently without constant supervision.

*Understand Boolean searches, recruiter research, and contact identification.



Previous experience sourcing U.S.-based professional, defense, intelligence, technology, or customer-success roles is strongly preferred.



Project Length & Compensation



*Base compensation: $200 for the 30-day project, paid $50 weekly.

*Success bonus: $1,000 if I accept a job offer resulting directly from an opportunity you identified or applied to during the project. 

*Note: The bonus is earned if I accept an offer from a role you sourced even if the offer comes after the 30-day project ends.



When Applying

Please answer the following:

*Tell me about your previous recruiting, sourcing, virtual-assistant, or job-search experience.

*Have you previously applied to U.S.-based jobs on behalf of another person?

*Have you sourced professional, technical, defense, intelligence, or customer-success roles before?

*How do you determine whether a candidate is actually qualified for a position?

*How would you identify the correct recruiter or hiring manager for a job posting?

*Approximately how many quality applications could you reasonably complete each business day?

*Which job-search and sourcing platforms are you most experienced using?

*How would you organize and track applications and outreach contacts?

*What would your strategy be if the goal was to help someone secure a new job within 30 days?



I am looking for someone who is proactive, organized, resourceful, and willing to take ownership of the search.

SEO Manager – Application Instructions



To be considered for the SEO Manager position, please complete the following steps.



Step 1 – Answer These 10 Questions

:



How many years of hands-on SEO experience do you have?

What types of businesses or industries have you worked with?

What SEO tools do you currently use? Please include tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or others.

Explain how you would perform an SEO audit on a website that is not generating enough organic leads.

How do you d
 which keywords are worth targeting? Explain how you separate high-value commercial keywords from keywords that may generate traffic but few leads.

What is your experience with Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization?

How do you approach backlink building? Give examples of backlink strategies you have personally used.

If a website has good traffic but is not generating leads, what would you investigate and change?

Are you available to work full-time from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time, and are you able to commit exclusively to this position during those working hours?

The video does not need to be professionally edited. We want to hear directly from you and understand your communication skills, SEO knowledge, and experience.



Please keep the video approximately 5–10 minutes.



Step 3 – Submit Your Application



Send your application by
 to:







 Subject:



SEO Manager Answering 10 Questions



Your
 must include:



Answers to all 10 questions

Your resume

A Google Drive link to your video

Any SEO portfolio, ranking reports, screenshots, or case studies you would like us to review

Important



The video must be submitted through Google Drive only.



Please make sure the Google Drive sharing permissions are set so that anyone with the link can view the video.



Applications that do not include the 10 answers and Google Drive video may not be considered.



### Responsibilities



* Develop and execute the complete SEO strategy

* Perform keyword and competitor research

* Identify high-value commercial keywords

* Create and manage SEO content plans

* Write or manage optimized service pages, location pages, blogs, and landing pages

* Optimize existing website pages

* Manage on-page SEO, including titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, and schema

* Perform technical SEO audits and coordinate corrections

* Monitor indexing, crawling, Core Web Vitals, and website performance

* Build high-quality backlinks and improve domain authority

* Manage local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization

* Track rankings, traffic, conversions, calls, and qualified leads

* Use Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and other SEO tools

* Analyze competitors and identify opportunities to outrank them

* Produce a monthly SEO performance and lead-generation report



### Required Experience



* 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience

* Proven examples of websites you personally helped rank

* Strong technical SEO knowledge

* Excellent keyword research skills

* Experience with local and service-business SEO

* Experience creating pages designed to generate leads—not just traffic

* Strong understanding of WordPress

* Experience with Google Analytics and Google Search Console

* Experience with Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar tools

* Strong written English



### What We Care About



We are not looking for someone who simply sends SEO reports.



We want someone who can demonstrate:



**Keyword → Ranking → Traffic → Lead → Revenue**



Candidates should be prepared to show real examples of rankings and organic growth they have achieved.



### Position Expectations



* Full-time position

* Available during **8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time**

* Long-term position

* Must be highly organized and accountable

* Must be able to work independently and provide measurable results

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager – Tickin Nutrition



We are looking for a Social Media Manager who can take full ownership of Tickin's social media and help us build a strong and recognizable brand online.



We are looking for someone who is creative, organized, proactive, and understands how to grow a brand through great content.



About Tickin

Tickin is a wellness brand built around one simple belief: better nights create better days.

Our first product is a premium nighttime gummy made with functional mushrooms and research-backed ingredients, designed to help people unwind, sleep better, and wake up feeling refreshed.

We want to make nighttime wellness feel simple, enjoyable, and something people actually look forward to. We're building a modern, trusted brand with a strong focus on quality, education, community, and great content.



As we grow Tickin, social media will play a major role in building our brand, connecting with our audience, and turning Tickin into a recognizable name in the wellness space.



Your Role:

You will be responsible for managing Tickin's social media from A to Z.

We don't want someone who only waits for instructions or simply schedules posts. We are looking for someone who understands the brand, brings new ideas, sees opportunities, and takes responsibility for growing our social media presence.



What You Will Do:

- Create and manage our social media content

- Plan weekly and monthly content calendars

- Create posts, carousels, stories, Reels, and short-form videos

- Write clear and engaging captions

- Post and schedule content consistently

- Manage Instagram, TikTok,
, and other relevant platforms

- Research trends and turn them into content ideas that fit our brand

- Research competitors and other successful wellness brands

- Come up with new ideas to grow Tickin's social media presence

- Engage with followers and respond to comments and messages

- Help build an active community around Tickin

- Find and research influencers and content creators

- Help coordinate influencer and creator collaborations

- Make sure creators and their audiences fit our target audience

- Review creator content and make sure it fits our brand

- Track engagement, reach, follower growth, and other important metrics

- Analyze which content performs best

- Provide regular updates on what is working and what we can improve

- Keep our social media professional, active, and consistent with the Tickin brand



Who We Are Looking For

You are a good fit if you:



- Have experience managing social media for a brand

- Understand Instagram, TikTok, Reels, Stories, and short-form content

- Understand what makes people stop scrolling and engage with content

- Have a good eye for branding, design, and aesthetics

- Know how to use Canva

- Can do basic video editing

- Understand engagement, reach, audience demographics, and social media analytics

- Can research trends and turn them into original ideas

- Can work independently without needing instructions for every small task

- Are proactive and regularly bring your own ideas

- Are organized and can plan content ahead

- Have good written English

- Are reliable and communicate clearly

- Experience with e-commerce, wellness brands, UGC, and influencer marketing is a big plus.



What We Expect:



We are looking for someone who takes ownership.

You should not need us to tell you exactly what to post every day. We want you to understand Tickin, understand our target audience, research what works, create a plan, and execute it consistently.



Working Hours, Salary & Bonuses:

This position will start part-time at 4 hours per day, with a salary of $200 per month.

We see this as a long-term position. If everything goes well and we are happy with the collaboration and results, we can increase the role to full-time at $400 per month as Tickin grows. There will also be opportunities to earn additional performance-based bonuses for great work and strong results.



We also want someone who is always thinking:



What can we do better? What content should we try next? How can we grow the brand?



Our goal is not just to get more followers. We want to build a real community, create strong brand awareness, increase engagement, and ultimately help Tickin grow.

title: Virtual Assistant – Marketing, PR & Online Research | Project-Based, Potential Part-Time
description:

title: Credit Disputer
description:
**CREDIT DISPUTE SPECIALIST – PAID PER ROUND**



**Epitome Vault Financial** is looking for an experienced Credit Dispute Specialist to join our growing credit repair company on a **project/round-based basis**.



We are looking for someone who already has experience analyzing credit reports and preparing legitimate, individualized disputes.



### What You'll Do



• Review Equifax, Experian & TransUnion credit reports

• Identify potential inaccuracies and reporting inconsistencies

• Analyze account details, balances, dates, payment history, status, etc.

• Prepare individualized dispute letters based on our SOPs

• Assist with CRA and furnisher disputes

• Review dispute responses and determine next steps

• Research FCRA provisions when appropriate

• Understand FTC/CROA requirements

• Understand CFPB complaint procedures and when escalation may be appropriate

• Document everything accurately in our CRM

• Help track each client's dispute rounds and results



### What We Need



You MUST have previous experience in:



* Credit repair / credit disputes

* Reading and analyzing credit reports

* Equifax, Experian & TransUnion disputes

* FCRA

* CRA vs. furnisher disputes

* FTC/CROA

* CFPB complaint process



**Credit Repair Cloud experience is a BIG PLUS.**



We are NOT looking for someone who simply sends generic dispute letters.



You must be able to explain **WHY** an account may be inaccurate and what evidence should be reviewed.



### Compensation



This is a **project-based position paid per completed client dispute round**, not a monthly salary.



Starting pay: **$15–$25 per completed round**, depending on complexity and experience.



As our client base grows, there will be opportunities for additional work and increased compensation.



### To Apply



Please start your application with:



**"I UNDERSTAND CREDIT REPORTS."**



Then answer these 5 questions:



1. How many years of credit repair/dispute experience do you have?



2. Have you worked with Credit Repair Cloud? If yes, explain how.



3. What is the difference between a CRA dispute and a furnisher dispute?



4. Name 3 things you look for when analyzing a credit report for potential inaccuracies.



5. Briefly explain your experience with FCRA, FTC/CROA, and CFPB complaints.



**Serious applicants only.**



We are looking for someone reliable, detail-oriented, knowledgeable, and interested in growing with a long-term company.

title: SEO / AEO / GEO Specialist + Website UI/UX Designer for Healthcare SaaS Website
description:
We are looking for an experienced digital marketing and website optimization specialist to help improve and implement changes to our healthcare software website.



****MUST BE ABLE TO WORK ON EASTER USA TIMEZONE***



We already have a number of recommendations and concepts for improving the site, including:



* Website graphic and UI/UX improvements

* SEO optimization

* AEO — Answer Engine Optimization

* GEO — Generative Engine Optimization

* Content structure improvements

* Landing page improvements

* Conversion optimization



We are looking for someone who can take these recommendations and actually implement them on the website.



This is not just an SEO consulting project. We need someone who is comfortable working across website design, content optimization, technical SEO, and AI-search optimization.



Scope of Work



The selected freelancer will help us:



Website Design / UI Improvements



* Improve the overall look and professionalism of the website

* Implement new page layouts and graphic concepts

* Improve homepage and landing page design

* Improve navigation and calls to action

* Make pages easier to scan and understand

* Improve mobile responsiveness

* Recommend and implement conversion improvements



SEO



* Perform technical and on-page SEO improvements

* Improve page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, and URL structure

* Improve keyword targeting

* Build or improve service and specialty landing pages

* Identify content gaps

* Optimize existing content

* Implement schema / structured data where appropriate

* Improve site speed and technical performance where possible



AEO — Answer Engine Optimization



We want the website structured so it has a better chance of appearing as the direct answer to questions on Google and other search platforms.



This includes:



* Question-and-answer content

* FAQ optimization

* Featured-snippet style content

* Clear definitions and explanations

* Structured content that search engines can easily understand

* Schema markup

* Building pages around actual questions prospective customers ask



GEO — Generative Engine Optimization



We also want to improve our visibility in AI-generated search and recommendation platforms such as:



* ChatGPT

* Google Gemini / AI Overviews

* Perplexity

* Microsoft Copilot

* Claude and other AI search tools



The goal is to increase the likelihood that our company and products are mentioned, referenced, or recommended when people ask AI systems questions such as:



* What are the best EHR systems for behavioral health?

* What EHRs are good for New York healthcare providers?

* What are alternatives to large EHR vendors?

* What EHR supports DSMES, NDPP, public health, ambulatory care, and specialty practices?



The freelancer should understand or be willing to implement GEO strategies involving:



* Entity optimization

* Topical authority

* Comparison pages

* "Best of" and alternative pages

* Authoritative educational content

* Third-party citations and mentions

* Consistent company information across the web

* Original research/data where appropriate

* Structured content that AI engines can easily interpret



About the Company



We are an established healthcare software / Electronic Health Record company serving healthcare organizations and medical practices.



Our platform includes EHR, practice management, billing, patient engagement, telemedicine, integrations, and specialty healthcare workflows.



Healthcare software experience is strongly preferred.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate should have experience with several of the following:



* SEO

* Technical SEO

* AEO

* GEO / AI search optimization

* SaaS website optimization

* UI/UX design

* Landing page design

* Conversion Rate Optimization

* WordPress or comparable CMS platforms

* Schema markup / structured data

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics

* Page speed optimization

* Content strategy

* Competitive SEO research



Experience with healthcare, EHR/EMR, SaaS, medical technology, or B2B software would be a major advantage.



 Important



We are not looking for someone who only provides an SEO audit or a report.



We want someone who can:



**Review recommendations → prioritize them → implement them → measure the results.**



There may be ongoing work available if the initial project goes well.



 When Applying



Please include:



1. Examples of websites you have personally improved or optimized

2. Specific SEO results you achieved

3. Any experience with AEO or GEO / AI search optimization

4. Experience implementing schema and structured data

5. Examples of website redesign or UI/UX work

6. Any healthcare or SaaS experience

7. What tools you use for SEO and competitive research

8. Whether you personally implement the changes or rely on another developer



Please also answer this question:



**If you were trying to get a healthcare SaaS company recommended by ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity, what are the first five things you would do?**



Generic or AI-generated applications that do not specifically address our project may not be considered.

title: Video editing for social media
description:
???? Full-Time Video Editor – YouTube, Reels & Short-Form Content



We are looking for an exceptionally talented Video Editor to join our team on a full-time, long-term basis.



This isn’t a role for someone who simply knows how to cut clips together.



We’re looking for someone who understands how to turn raw footage into high-quality, engaging content that captures attention, tells a story and keeps people watching.



The majority of the content will be personal-brand / educational content around mindset, personal development, business and transformation.



You will primarily be editing:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok videos

*
 Reels

* YouTube Shorts

* Long-form YouTube videos

* Talking-head / educational videos

* Promotional and marketing videos



???? What We’re Looking For



You should be someone who is highly creative and exceptionally good at video editing.



You understand that great editing isn’t about adding as many effects as possible.



It’s about attention, pacing, emotion, storytelling and retention.



You should know how to take relatively simple talking-head footage and turn it into something that feels professional, engaging and premium.



You should be confident with things such as:



* Strong hooks and opening sequences

* Fast, engaging pacing

* Removing unnecessary pauses and dead space

* Professional captions and subtitles

* B-roll that enhances what is being said

* Punch-ins, zooms and camera movements

* Motion graphics and animations

* Sound effects and sound design

* Background music

* Colour correction and grading

* Audio enhancement

* Seamless transitions

* Pattern interrupts

* Visual storytelling

* Creating content designed for audience retention



???? Software & Technical Skills



You should be highly proficient with industry-leading editing software and tools such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Adobe After Effects

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut

* Adobe Photoshop

* AI-powered video and content tools



You don’t necessarily need to use every application above, but you should have a professional editing workflow and be comfortable learning and using new technology.



Knowledge of AI tools that can improve editing speed, B-roll, captions, audio, graphics or workflow is a big advantage.



???? You Need to Understand Content



This is extremely important.



We don’t want an editor who needs to be told:



“Zoom here.”



“Put B-roll here.”



“Add a sound effect here.”



We want someone who can watch the raw footage, understand the message and use their own creativity and judgement to make the content better.



You should understand what performs well on Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube and stay up to date with current editing styles and trends.



You should constantly be thinking:



“How can I make this more engaging?”



⭐ The Ideal Person



You are:



* Creative

* Reliable

* Detail-oriented

* Fast without sacrificing quality

* Excellent at communication

* Able to meet deadlines

* Open to feedback

* Constantly improving your skills

* Passionate about video and content

* Interested in social media and content trends

* Able to work independently

* Looking for a stable, long-term position



We want someone who will eventually understand our brand and editing style so well that we can provide the raw footage and trust you to take ownership of the edit.



???? Position



Full-Time / Long-Term



This is not a one-off freelance project.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the team and grow with the brand over the long term.



There will be a consistent flow of video content to edit each week.



???? Salary



Competitive monthly salary based on your experience, skill level and the quality of your work.



There will also be opportunities to grow within the role for the right person.



???? How To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. How many years you’ve been editing professionally.

3. The software you primarily use.

4. 3 examples of your BEST short-form edits.

5. 1 example of your BEST long-form YouTube edit.

6. Examples of talking-head / personal-brand content you’ve edited.

7. Your expected monthly salary for a full-time position.

8. Your availability and timezone.



Please do not send 20+ portfolio links.



We would rather see the 3–5 pieces of work you’re most proud of.



Final Stage



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a short paid editing test using footage we provide.



This allows us to see your creativity, editing style and how you approach our specific type of content.



If you’re an exceptional editor who loves turning ideas and raw footage into content people actually want to watch, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Social Content & Growth Associate
description:
Remote | Philippines

$7 USD/hour | Approx. 8 hours per week



I’m looking for a smart, reliable and visually strong Social Content & Growth Associate to help build the organic social presence of a new professional brand from the ground up.



This is not a traditional social media manager role, and it is not just a Canva production role.



You will be responsible for helping turn our ideas, research and brand direction into a consistent stream of strong social content, using AI extensively as part of the workflow.



The brand is still early-stage, so this is a chance to help shape how the social presence develops from the beginning.



What you’ll be responsible for



Content creation

* Turn existing ideas, research, articles and brand material into social content

* Use ChatGPT, Claude and Canva to develop post concepts, captions, carousels and other content

* Create approximately 3–5 strong pieces of content per week

* Work within an established visual identity and brand system

* Adapt content for Instagram and, where relevant, LinkedIn

* Schedule and publish approved content

* Keep the content calendar organized



You should be comfortable starting with a rough idea rather than waiting for fully written copy.



For example, I may give you a research finding, article or theme and expect you to use AI and your own judgment to turn that into several useful content angles.



Organic growth



You will also help grow the account without paid media.



This includes:

* identifying relevant accounts and audiences

* engaging thoughtfully with relevant posts

* responding to straightforward comments

* finding conversations our brand should participate in

* identifying potential collaborations or useful accounts to connect with

* watching what formats and topics perform well

* suggesting content we should create more of

* helping build a small but highly relevant audience

What I am not looking for

* “5 tips” graphics

Hours and pay



$7 USD per hour



Approximately 8 hours per week initially.

You do not need to work UK hours, although occasional overlap for communication is helpful.

How to apply



Please send:

If you joined a brand with fewer than 100 followers, no paid media budget and a strong library of original research, what would you do in your first 30 days to help grow a relevant audience?

CONCENTRIC SOCIAL

title: Instagram Outreach & Lead Generation VA
description:
Instagram Outreach & Lead Generation VA



**Cam in a Box RE Media | Remote | Part-Time**



Are you naturally good at starting conversations with people online?



Do you enjoy Instagram, discovering new people, and making genuine connections? Are you organized, consistent, and comfortable following a process while still using good judgment?



If so, you may be exactly who we're looking for.



About Cam in a Box



We are a growing real estate media company serving real estate agents in the Raleigh, NC area.



We provide professional photography, drone photography, video, floor plans, 3D tours, and other marketing services that help real estate agents market their listings and grow their businesses.



We're a small team, and we're looking to hire a Virtual Assistant to help us grow.



This isn't a traditional VA position where you'll spend your day answering
s or doing random administrative tasks.



Your primary responsibility will be helping us find and connect with potential real estate agent clients on Instagram.



We'll provide the training, systems, scripts, and processes. Your job will be to consistently execute the system, build genuine interactions, and help turn conversations into opportunities for us to work with new agents.



What You'll Be Doing



Instagram Prospecting



You'll spend a significant part of your day finding real estate agents in our target market on Instagram.



You'll:



* Search Instagram for real estate agents in the Raleigh/Triangle area.

* Identify agents who appear to be a good fit for our services.

* Research their profiles and content to make sure we're reaching out to the right people.

* Keep track of prospects and their status.

* Follow our established prospecting criteria and outreach process.



Engagement & Relationship Building



We don't want to spam hundreds of agents with generic messages.



Our goal is to start real conversations and build genuine relationships.



You'll:



* Follow and interact with prospective agents' content when appropriate.

* Like and comment on posts according to our engagement guidelines.

* Pay attention to what agents are posting so our outreach feels personal rather than automated.

* Look for natural opportunities to start conversations.

* Follow our engagement and messaging system consistently.



Instagram Outreach



Once a prospect reaches the appropriate stage in our process, you'll send our pre-written outreach messages.



You'll:



* Send our approved messages to qualified prospects.

* Personalize messages when appropriate.

* Respond to basic conversations using our scripts and guidelines.

* Follow up with prospects according to our follow-up schedule.

* Identify agents who are interested and move them to the next step in our process.

* Help get qualified agents booked for our **free introductory shoot**.



You will not be expected to create your own sales pitch from scratch.



We'll give you the messaging, training, examples, and process you'll need.



Tracking & Organization



Consistency is extremely important in this role.



You'll be responsible for keeping our outreach organized so we always know:



* Who we've contacted

* Who has responded

* Who needs a follow-up

* Who is interested

* Who has booked

* Who should not be contacted again



You'll use the systems we provide to keep this information accurate and up to date.



What Success Looks Like



We aren't looking for someone who simply sends the largest number of DMs possible.



A successful VA in this position will:



* Find quality prospects rather than contacting random accounts.

* Follow our outreach process consistently.

* Understand the difference between engagement and spam.

* Start genuine conversations.

* Follow up when appropriate.

* Keep excellent records.

* Help create a steady flow of conversations with local real estate agents.

* Ultimately help us book more free shoots with qualified agents.



Quality and consistency are more important to us than simply hitting a huge DM number.



What We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if you are:



* Comfortable using Instagram every day.

* A strong written communicator in English.

* Naturally friendly and personable.

* Good at noticing details.

* Organized and consistent.

* Comfortable following a system and repeating it accurately.

* Able to recognize when something feels natural versus overly salesy.

* Self-motivated and able to work independently.

* Comfortable communicating professionally with real estate agents.

* Willing to learn our specific process and improve over time.



Experience that would be helpful:



* Instagram outreach

* Lead generation

* Social media management

* Appointment setting

* Real estate

* Sales or customer service

* Community management



You do not need to have experience in all of these areas.



We're more interested in your communication skills, work ethic, attention to detail, and ability to learn our system.



Important: This Is NOT a Spam Job



We want to be very clear about this.



We're not looking for someone who will copy and paste the same message to hundreds of people every day without paying attention to who they're contacting.



Our brand is built around relationships.



We want agents to feel like they're talking to a real person who actually looked at their profile and understands what they do.



If your approach to Instagram outreach is simply:



Find account → send DM → move to next account



this probably isn't the right position for you.



We're looking for someone who can follow a proven system while still using common sense and good judgment.



Schedule



We're looking for someone who can work a consistent schedule during our business hours.



Initial schedule: Part-time, approximately 4 hours per day, 5 days per week.



Our business operates on Eastern Time (U.S.), and you'll need to have reliable availability during the agreed-upon working hours.



The exact schedule will be discussed during the hiring process.



What We Provide



You won't be thrown into the job and expected to figure everything out yourself.



We'll provide:



* Training on our Instagram outreach system

* Pre-written messaging scripts

* Prospecting guidelines

* Follow-up procedures

* Examples of successful conversations

* The tools you'll need to do the job

* Ongoing feedback and support



You'll be working directly with the owners of the business, so your work will have a real impact on our growth.



Why Work With Us?



We're a small but growing business.



That means you'll have the opportunity to become an important part of the company as we grow.



We're looking for someone who wants more than just a job where they clock in, complete a checklist, and clock out.



If you do well in this position, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and grow with the business.



We're a friendly team, we work hard, and we like to have fun while we're doing it.



How to Apply



We want to make sure we're finding someone who is genuinely interested in this position and actually reads the job description.



Please send us the following:



1. Your resume or work history.

2. A short video introducing yourself and telling us why you think you'd be a good fit for this position.

3. A screenshot of your internet speed test.

4. Your answers to the questions below.



Application Questions



1. What experience do you have with Instagram?



2. Have you ever done social media outreach, lead generation, appointment setting, or sales? If so, tell us about it.



3. Imagine you find a Raleigh real estate agent on Instagram who you think would be a great prospect for us. What would you look at on their profile before deciding to reach out.



4. What do you think is the difference between genuine Instagram engagement and spam?



5. Tell us about a time you had to follow a repetitive process consistently. How did you make sure you didn't become careless or miss steps?



6. What is your availability in U.S. Eastern Time?



7. What are your expected monthly salary requirements for a part-time position?



One More Thing...



At the beginning of your application, please tell us:



What is your favorite thing about Instagram?



This helps us make sure you read the entire posting.



We're excited to meet you and find the person who will become the first member of our VA team!



Cam in a Box RE Media

Raleigh, NC

title: Software Engineering Intern / Junior Software Engineer

LICENSED CARE MN

Minnesota's DHS-licensed care provider directory

About Licensed Care MN

Licensed Care MN exists because finding a licensed place for someone you love shouldn't take an afternoon of cold calls and crossed fingers. We're building the search platform Minnesota families and case managers actually need — pulling straight from the state's own DHS licensing records so every provider you find is real, current, and verifiable, never a scraped listing or a pay-to-play ad. Today we're a small team proving that idea works, with a real, working prototype already live; ahead of us is the much bigger build — a production backend, AI-assisted content, and a platform ready to serve every licensed operator in the state. Join us now and you're not joining a finished company, you're helping build one, with real ownership over the decisions that will shape how thousands of Minnesota families find care for the people they love.

The Role

We're looking for a software engineering intern or junior engineer to help take Licensed Care MN from its current static prototype toward the production architecture laid out in our technical spec. You'll work directly with the founder/technical lead, with real code review and mentorship —

What You'll Work On

Backend API work in Node.js/TypeScript, organized around domain modules (search, business listings, claims, admin).

PostgreSQL schema and query work — modeling operators, licensed locations, and claim/verification status.

Migrating pieces of the current static HTML/Python prototype to a Next.js-style React frontend (server-rendered for SEO, client-rendered for search and dashboards).

Data ingestion tooling for Minnesota DHS's public licensing exports — parsing, normalizing, and diffing licensing data over time.

Supporting work on our AI content pipeline: a provider-agnostic AI abstraction layer used for tasks like license-status summaries and business descriptions, with guardrails against fabricated data.

Writing tests and basic documentation as we go — the codebase is small enough right now that good habits here really matter.

Github understanding 

What We're Looking For

Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent self-taught experience.

Comfort with at least one of JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, and a genuine interest in web development.

Basic familiarity with SQL / relational databases.

Curiosity about how software gets built end-to-end — you're comfortable saying “I don't know, let me find out.”

Clear written communication — this is a remote, largely async role.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

Exposure to React or Next.js.

Exposure to calling LLM/AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar).

Interest in civic tech, healthcare access, or public-interest data projects.

Prior internship, coursework project, or personal project you can walk us through.

What We Offer.

Real ownership: your work will ship into a platform meant to help Minnesota families find licensed care.

Fully remote, flexible schedule — open to candidates anywhere in the world.

An honest, early-stage environment: we'll tell you plainly what's built, what's a prototype, and what's still just a plan.

How to Apply

Send a resume and a short note about a project you've built (school, personal, or professional — a GitHub link is great) to [application
 to be provided]. Tell us what interests you about Licensed Care MN specifically — we read every application.

Licensed Care MN is an early-stage prototype at the time of this posting. Company formation, funding, and hiring infrastructure are still being finalized — bracketed details above will be confirmed before this posting goes live.

description:
Job Title: Physician Licensing & Onboarding Specialist



Department: Credentialing



Reports To: VP of Revenue Cycle



Job Type: Full-time



Job Overview



We are seeking an organized, process-driven Physician Licensing & Onboarding Specialist to lead state medical licensing, license maintenance, and onboarding for our Rounding and Collaborating Physicians. In this role, your primary mission is to manage end-to-end state medical board applications, expedite multi-state licensing, and track active license renewals across target states. You will serve as the core liaison for our medical staff, ensuring full regulatory compliance, active state licensure, and seamless credentialing for rapid deployment into partner Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs). This role will also play a role in payer credentialing with the new provides.



Key Responsibilities:

• State Licensure & Multi-State Applications (Primary Focus): Direct end-to-end processing of state medical board applications for newly hired and existing physicians across target states; manage applications via state portals, FCVS, and the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC).



• Proactive License Renewals & Expiration Tracking: Monitor state license expiration timelines, state-specific Continuing Medical Education (CME) requirements, DEA registrations, and state controlled-substance permits to execute timely renewals and avoid operational downtime.



• Document Collection & Primary Source Verification: Gather, audit, and verify medical credentials, transcripts, background checks, malpractice coverage, and compliance records for Rounding and Collaborating Physicians.



• Collaborative Practice Agreement (CPA) Management: Execute and track state-compliant Collaborative Practice Agreements between Collaborating Physicians and Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) or facility rounding teams across SNF sites.



• Facility and Payer Credentialing & Physician Placement: Align verified state credentials, practice scopes, and active board privileges to match physician assignments with specific SNF facility standards. Familiar with payer credentialing for providers.



• Provider Onboarding & Administrative Support: Guide incoming physicians through operational onboarding, answering questions regarding state board requirements, facility placements, and administrative paperwork.



Qualifications & Requirements:

• Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in physician state licensing, medical board application management, or healthcare credentialing.



• Licensing Knowledge: Deep familiarity with state medical board regulations, multi-state licensure processes (including IMLC and FCVS), CME compliance, and license renewal cycles across multiple jurisdictions.



• Industry Context: Experience handling physician workflows within Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs), post-acute settings, or telemedicine systems preferred.



• Technical Skills: Proficiency with credentialing databases (e.g., Modio, Cactus, Council for Affordable Quality healthcare/CAQH), state portal systems, and Google Workspace/MS Office suite.



• Compliance & Detail: Exceptional attention to detail with proven ability to maintain strict HIPAA compliance when handling sensitive practitioner records.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – Fashion/Lifestyle TikTok & Reels
description:
## About Us



The Shortlist is a growing fashion-tech app that helps women better understand their personal style, make smarter wardrobe decisions, and get more out of the clothes they already own.



We're building our social presence primarily through TikTok and Instagram Reels, with founder-led content around personal style, closets, outfit decisions, shopping, and the process of building The Shortlist.



We're looking for a talented **short-form video editor** to help turn our raw footage into polished, engaging content that feels elevated while still feeling natural and native to social media.



## What You'll Edit



Approximately **20 short-form videos per month**, primarily 15–60 seconds each.



Content will include:



* Founder talking-to-camera videos

* GRWM and outfit content

* Closet and styling B-roll

* Voiceover videos

* App demonstrations and screen recordings

* Founder/building-a-business content



We will provide the raw footage along with the concept, hook, key message, and any specific direction needed.



## What We're Looking For



We want someone with a strong visual eye who understands **fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or premium consumer brands**.



Your edits should feel polished and intentional without looking overly produced.



Think:



* Strong opening hooks

* Excellent pacing and clean cuts

* Tasteful, modern captions and typography

* Strategic use of B-roll

* Clean audio and audio enhancement

* Basic color/exposure correction

* Music and subtle sound design when appropriate

* Thoughtful visual changes that improve retention

* A consistent visual identity across our content



We **do not** want overly aggressive editing, constant zooms, excessive effects, giant captions, or a generic "viral video" aesthetic.



The goal is **elevated, stylish, conversational and native to TikTok/Reels.**



## Who You Are



You:



* Have experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts

* Have a portfolio of short-form work

* Understand hooks, pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention

* Have strong aesthetic judgment

* Can work independently once you understand our style

* Communicate clearly and reliably

* Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* Ideally have experience with fashion, beauty, lifestyle, DTC brands, creators, or female founders



You can use CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or another professional editing platform. We care much more about the finished product than which software you use.



## Workflow



Our goal is to create a simple ongoing system:



**We provide:** raw footage + concept + hook + creative direction



**You provide:** polished, ready-to-post TikTok/Reel



As we work together, we'd like to develop several repeatable editing styles/templates so that less direction is required for each video.



## Schedule & Compensation



This is an **ongoing part-time freelance position**.



Expected volume: approximately **20 videos/month**



Budget: **$400–$500 USD/month**, depending on experience, quality, and final scope.



We're looking for someone interested in developing a long-term relationship with the brand as we grow.



## Paid Editing Trial



Finalists will be invited to complete a **paid editing trial** using real raw footage from The Shortlist.



We will provide the same footage and creative direction to each finalist. This is paid work — we do not expect applicants to create free sample edits.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

2. Links to the **3 short-form videos you've edited that best represent the aesthetic you would bring to a women's fashion/lifestyle brand.**

3. Your role in creating those videos.

4. The editing software you primarily use.

5. Your typical turnaround time for a short-form video.

6. Your expected monthly rate for approximately 20 videos.



**Please do not send a large general portfolio. We specifically want to see the three examples you believe are most relevant to this brand and editing style.**
